verses.text: Salomo mwene Dawidi aba agakomeye mu bwami bwiwe, kuko Uhoraho Imana yiwe yari kumwe na we kandi amugira uwuhambaye cane.
Maze Salomo avugana n’Abisirayeli bose, abatwara ingabo ibihumbi n’abatwara ingabo amajana, abacamanza, abarongozi, b’Abisirayeli bose n’abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza.
Maze Salomo n’abantu bose baja kw’itaba ry’umusozi i Gibeyoni, kuko Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ry’Imana ari ho ryari rishinzwe, iryo Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarakoze bakiri mu bugaragwa.
Ico gihe Dawidi yari yaramaze kuzana Isandugu y’Imana ayikura i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu ayijana mu kibanza yari yayiteguriye, kuko yari yarayishingiye ihema i Yerusalemu.

Ariko ca gicaniro gikozwe mu butare bw’umwakaka ico Bezaleli mwene Uri, Uri mwene Huri, yari yarakoze cari kikiri i Gibeyoni imbere y’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho . Aho ni ho Salomo n’ikoraniro ryose bambariza Uhoraho .
Salomo araduga aja kuri ca gicaniro c’ubutare bw’umwakaka cari imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro aca agitangirako ibimazi igihumbi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro.
Muri iryo joro Imana yiyereka Salomo iramubwira iti: “Nsaba ico ushaka cose ndakiguha.”
Salomo yishura Imana ati: “Wagiriye neza cane data Dawidi maze ungira umwami mu kibanza ciwe.
None rero, Uhoraho Mana, nushitse isezerano wasezeraniye data Dawidi, kuko wanyimitse ngo mbe umwami w’ihanga ry’abantu benshi bangana nk’umukungugu wo kw’isi.
Numpe ubwenge n’ubumenyi, kugira ngo nshobore kurongora ubu bwoko. Mbega none ni nde yoshobora kuganza ubu bwoko bwawe bwinshi bungana gutya?”

Imana ibwira Salomo iti: “Ko ico ari co umutima wawe wipfuza ukaba utansavye ubutunzi, ibintu canke icubahiro, canke ngo unsabe ko abansi bawe bapfa; kandi ko utansavye kuramba ariko ukansaba ubwenge n’ubumenyi kugira ngo ushobore kuganza neza abantu banje, abo naguhaye ngo ubabere umwami;

nuko ubwenge n’ubumenyi ndabiguhaye. Kandi nzoguha ubutunzi n’ibintu vyinshi, icubahiro no kuba rurangiranwa, ku buryo ata mwami n’umwe mu bakwitangiye imbere bose yigeze kuronka nk’ivyo, canke ngo habe n’umwe azobironka mu bazoza inyuma yawe.”
Nuko Salomo aja i Yerusalemu avuye imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ryari kw’itaba ry’umusozi Gibeyoni. Maze akomeza ivy’ubwami bwiwe mu Bisirayeli.

Maze Salomo yegeranya imikogote y’intambara n’amafarasi menshi. Yari afise imikogote igihumbi n’amajana ane, n’amafarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri. Bimwe abibika mu bisagara vy’imikogote, ibindi abigumiza hafi yiwe i Yerusalemu.
Umwami agwiza ifeza n’inzahabu i Yerusalemu bisigara bimeze nk’amabuye, imbaho z’agaciro z’amasederi na zo ziragwira zimera nk’ibiti vy’imisukomora vyo mu biyaya vy’i Buyuda.
Amafarasi ya Salomo yari yayakuye muri Egiputa n’i Kilikiya; abadandaza b’umwami bari bayaguriye muri Kilikiya ku giciro gisanzwe.

Umukogote umwe bawugura muri Egiputa shekeli amajana atandatu z’ifeza, ifarasi imwe na yo bakayigura shekeli ijana na mirongo itanu. Kandi abo badandaza ni bo banabigurisha no ku bami bose b’Abaheti n’ab’Abarameya.
Salomo yigira ingingo yo kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba ciwe,
ashiraho abagabo ibihumbi mirongo indwi bo kwikorera ibikoresho n’abandi ibihumbi mirongo umunani bo kubaza amabuye bayakura mu misozi, n’abashika ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu bo kubakoresha.
Salomo arungika intumwa kuri Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro ati: “Ndungikira ibiti vy’amasederi nk’uko wabigiriye data Dawidi aho wamurungikira amasederi yo kwubaka ikirimba ciwe.

Ubu ngira nubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yanje. Kizoba ari ikibanza catoranirijwe gutuririramwo ibimota neza imbere yayo, aho gushira imikate ihezagiye ubudasiba, no gushikaniramwo ibimazi biturijwe umuriro ku murango, ku mugoroba, ku masabato, mu mboneko z’ukwezi hamwe rero no ku misi mikuru yashinzwe n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu. Kandi ivyo ni icagezwe cahawe Abisirayeli ibihe vyose.
Iyo Ngoro ngira nubake izoba iteye igomwe, kuko Imana yacu ari iyihambaye kurusha ibindi vyitwa imana vyose.

Ariko, mbega ni nde yoshobora kuyubakira inzu ibamwo? Ko amajuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, idashobora kuyakwirwamwo! None jewe ndi iki ngo ndayubakire Ingoro, kiretse gusa kwubaka ahantu ho kuyituririra ibimazi!

Nuko, ndungikira umuntu w’umuhinga azi gukora ivy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza, ivy’ubutare bw’umwakaka n’ivy’ivyuma; ivy’amarangi y’agahama, n’ay’ubururu ari ku bitambara. Yoba kandi azi ubuhinga bwo gutunganya amashusho ayarumika aho akwiye, agashobora gukorana n’abahinga b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, abo Data Dawidi yateguye.
Undungikire kandi ibiti vy’amasederi n’ivy’amapinusi n’ivy’amasantali vy’i Libani, kuko ndazi ko abantu bawe ari abahinga mu vyo kubaza imbaho zo hiyo. Abantu banje bazokorana n’abawe
ngo bantegurire imbaho nyinshi, kuko Ingoro nzokwubaka ibwirizwa kuba yagutse kandi ishajije.

Abakozi bawe, abantu bo kubaza imbaho, nzobaha ingero koru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’ingano, ingero koru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri za sayiri, ingero batu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’umuvinyu, n’ingero batu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’amavuta ya elayo.”
Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro yishura Salomo mw’ikete yamwandikiye ati: “ Uhoraho arakunda abantu biwe, ni co catumye akugira umwami wabo.”

Kandi Hiramu arongera ati: “ Uhoraho ahimbazwe, Imana y’Abisirayeli, yaremye ijuru n’isi! Yahaye umwami Dawidi umuhungu w’ubwenge, yuzuye n’ubumenyi bwo kumenya ibibereye, akaba ari we azokwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba ciwe c’ubwami.
Ndakurungikiye Huramu Abi, umuntu w’umuhinga cane,

nyina wiwe akomoka mu muryango wa Dani, se na we ava i Tiro. Yigishijwe gukora ibintu bitandukanye mu nzahabu, mw’ifeza, mu miringa n’ivyuma, mu mabuye n’ibiti, ivy’amabara atukura n’ay’ubururu, n’ayavanze y’ubururu n’agahama, n’ayera derere. Ni umuhinga amenyereye ivyo kubaza amashusho kandi ashobora gukora ivyo womusaba vyose. Azokorana n’abahinga bawe n’aba databuja, so wawe Dawidi.
None rero nyakwubahwa urungikire abasavyi bawe za ngano na sayiri na ya mavuta ya elayo na wa muvinyu nk’uko wasezeranye,
natwe tuzoca ibiti vyose mukeneye vy’i Libani tubizane ku kiyaga gushika i Yopa. Namwe muzoheza mubitoreho mubidugane i Yerusalemu.”
Salomo aharura abantu bose b’inyambukira bari muri Isirayeli, inyuma y’iharura ryari ryakozwe na se Dawidi; basanga ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana atandatu.

Atoranya ibihumbi mirongo indwi bo muri bo abashinga kuba abikorezi abandi ibihumbi mirongo umunani abashinga kuba abo kubaza amabuye mu misozi, abandi ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu abashinga kuba abakoresha abandi baraba ko abantu bariko barakora.

Maze Salomo atangura kwubakira Uhoraho Ingoro i Yerusalemu ku musozi Moriya, hamwe Uhoraho yari yariyerekeye se Dawidi. Hari ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi, ikibanza cari categuwe na Dawidi.
Atangura kwubaka ku musi ugira kabiri w’ukwezi kwa kabiri mu mwaka ugira kane ari ku ngoma.
Umushinge Salomo yubatse wo kwubakako iyo Ngoro y’Imana wari ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke.

Ibaraza ry’amaja imbere y’iyo Ngoro ryari rifise uburebure bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri hamwe n’igihagararo kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri nyene. Imbere mu Ngoro ahomeka inzahabu ihinguwe neza.
Icumba gikuru acubakisha imbaho z’amasederi, azomekako inzahabu zihinguwe neza, hanyuma ashushanyako ibigazi n’imigufu.
Ashariza impome z’Ingoro n’amabuye y’igiciro kinini. Inzahabu yakoresheje zavuye i Paruvayimu.
Imyamba ifashe igisenge, ibishimaryango, impome hamwe n’imiryango y’Ingoro avyomekako inzahabu, hanyuma impome azishushanyako abakerubi.

Yubaka Ahera Cane, uburebure bwaho bwangana n’ubwaguke bw’Ingoro; ni ukuvuga ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri hamwe rero n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke. Imbere ahomeka inzahabu ihinguwe neza ipima italanto amajana atandatu.
Imisumari y’inzahabu yapima shekeli mirongo itanu. Ivyumba vyo hejuru na vyo nyene avyomekako inzahabu.
Abaza ibishushanyo bibiri vy’abakerubi vyo gushira Ahera Cane, avyomekako inzahabu.

Ubwaguke bw’amababa y’abo bakerubi uko ari babiri bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri. Ibaba rimwe ry’umukerubi wa mbere ryari rifise uburebure bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu kandi ryakora ku ruhome rw’Ingoro, mu gihe irindi baba, na ryo nyene rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu, ryafatana n’ibaba ry’uwundi mukerubi.

Ibaba ry’umukerubi wa kabiri ryapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu rigakora ku kindi gihome c’urusengero, irindi baba na ryo nyene ryapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure, rigakora kw’ibaba ry’umukerubi wa mbere.
Amababa y’abo bakerubi yari afise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri. Bari bahagaze, batumbereye Ahera Cane.
Ashona igihuzu mu nyuzi z’amabara y’ubururu avanze n’ayatukura hamwe n’ayera derere, gishushanijweko abakerubi.

Imbere y’Ingoro yubaka inkingi zibiri, zose hamwe zareha n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu na zitanu z’uburebure bw’igihagararo, imwe yose ku mutwe yari ifise umwashi upima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu.
Akora imigufu isobekeranye ayishira ku mitwe y’izo nkingi, aca acura ibisa n’ivyamwa vyitwa amakomamanga ijana abimanika kuri iyo migufu.
Ahagarika za nkingi imbere y’Ingoro, imwe ayishira amaja mu bumanuko iyindi amaja mu buraruko. Iyo mu bumanuko ayita Yakini, iyo mu buraruko ayita Bowazi.

Salomo acurisha mu butare bwitwa umwakaka igicaniro kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke hamwe n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi z’igihagararo.

Yongera akoresha ibesani nini ayita ikiyaga, bayikora ari umuzingi mu butare bw’umwakaka. Ubwaguke bwayo ku rubiga, uva ku ruhande rumwe uja ku rundi uciye hagati bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi, kandi yari ifise igihagararo kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu. Uburebure bw’uwo muzingi na wo uwuzungurutse bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu.

Musi y’urubiga, hari ibibumbano bisa n’impfizi z’inka bikikuje hose, vyari cumicumi ku hantu hangana n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe. Ivyo bibumbano vy’impfizi vyari bitonze ku mirongo ibiri bifatanye n’ico kiyaga gikozwe mu butare bw’umwakaka.

Iyo besani yari ihagaze ku bibumbano vy’impfizi cumi na zibiri zicuzwe mu butare bw’umwakaka, zitatu zikaraba mu buraruko, zitatu mu burengero, izindi zitatu mu bumanuko hamwe n’izindi zitatu zaraba mu buseruko. Iyo besani bita ikiyaga, yari iteretse hejuru kuri ivyo bibumbano vy’izo mpfizi, maze ibice vy’inyuma vyazo bikaraba hagati musi y’ico kiyaga.
Cari gifise intimbatimba ingana n’ikiganza c’umuntu, kandi urubiga rwaco rwari rumeze nk’urw’igikombe, nk’ishurwe ry’ikirungu risambuye. Cashobora kwuzuzwa n’ingero batu ibihumbi bitatu.

Salomo aca akoresha amabesani matomato cumi yo kwogerezamwo ibikoresho bakoresha mu gutanga ibimazi bitongozwa umuriro: atanu ayashira ku ruhande rw’ubumanuko, ayandi atanu ayashira ku ruhande rwo mu buraruko. Ariko ya besani yitwa ikiyaga, yari iyo abaherezi bakarabiramwo.
Salomo akoresha ibiterekwako amatara cumi nk’uko amategeko yavyo yari ari, abishira mu Ngoro, bitanu mu ruhande rw’ubumanuko, bindi bitanu mu ruhande rw’uburaruko.
Salomo akoresha imeza icumi azishira mu Ngoro, zitanu zija mu ruhande rwo mu bumanuko izindi zitanu zija mu ruhande rwo mu buraruko. Yongera akoresha mu nzahabu utubakure two kumijagira ijana.
Yubakisha n’ibaraza ry’abaherezi, hamwe n’ikindi kibanza c’ibaraza kinini. Aca akoresha n’inzugi z’imiryango ija muri ayo mabaraza, azomekako ubutare bw’umwakaka.
Ashira ya besani yitwa ikiyaga ku ruhande rw’ubumanuko, mu gice c’iyo Ngoro giherereye mu buseruko.
Huramu yarakoze kandi inkono, ivyaruzo, hamwe n’utubakure two kumijagira. Maze Huramu aheraheza ico gikorwa c’umwami Salomo yari yatanguye mu Ngoro y’Imana:
za nkingi zibiri; ya myashi ibiri imeze nk’ibikombe yo ku mutwe w’izo nkingi; ya migufu ibiri isobekeranye yo gushariza iyo myashi ibumbwe bwa bikombe biri ku mitwe y’izo nkingi;
vya bicurano bisa n’amakomamanga amajana ane yo kuri ya migufu ibiri; imirongo ibiri y’ibisa n’amakomamanga ku mugufu umwumwe usharije ya myashi iri ku mitwe ya za nkingi;
Ivyo guterekako ya mabesani hamwe n’ayo mabesani nyene;
ca kiyaga na vya bibumbano vy’amashuri cumi n’abiri cari giteretseko;

za nkono, vya vyaruzo, amakanya yo guterura inyama n’ibindi bikoresho bijanye na vyo. Ibikoresho vyose Huramu Abi yakoreye umwami Salomo ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho vyari mu butare bw’umwakaka uhinguwe neza.
Umwami ategeka ko bifyaturirwa mu maforoma y’ibumba mu kiyaya ca Yorodani hagati ya Sukoti na Zereda.
Ivyo bintu vyose Salomo yakoze vyari vyinshi cane ku buryo igipimo c’ubutare bw’umwakaka bwakoreshejwe kitashobora kumenyekana.
Salomo yongera akora ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’Imana: igicaniro c’inzahabu, imeza yo gushirako ya mikate ihezagiye,
vya biterekwako amatara vy’inzahabu ihinguwe neza n’amatara yavyo, yo kubonesha imbere y’Ahera Cane nk’uko vyategetswe;
ya mashurwe acuzwe mu nzahabu, amatara, n’ivyo kuyora umunyota vyose vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguye neza;
imbugita, utubakure, ibikombe n’udusahani tw’umunyota bicuzwe mu nzahabu ihinguye neza; n’inzugi z’Ingoro zikozwe mu nzahabu: inzugi zinjira Ahera n’iz’Ahera Cane.

Igikorwa cose Salomo yakoreye Ingoro y’ Uhoraho giheze, aca yinjiza ibintu vyose se Dawidi yari yaragize inyegu y’ Uhoraho : ifeza, inzahabu n’ibindi bikoresho abishira mu bubiko bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana.

Nuko umwami Salomo aca atumako abakuru b’Abisirayeli, abatware b’imiryango bose n’abaserukira amazu y’Abisirayeli, bakoranira i Yerusalemu kugira ngo bazane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , bayikure aho yari iri i Siyoni mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, bayijane mu kibanza gishasha kiri muri iyo Ngoro.
Abisirayeli bose bakoranira imbere y’umwami ku musi mukuru w’insago, hari mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli bamaze gushika, Abalewi baterura ya sandugu,
badugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho n’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, badugana n’ibikoresho vyose vyakoreshwa muri ryo. Abaherezi ari bo Balewi ni bo babiduganye.
Umwami Salomo n’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli bari bakoraniye hamwe bari imbere y’iyo sandugu, batanga ibimazi vyinshi vy’intama n’inka bitashoboye kwandikwa canke ngo biharurwe.
Abo baherezi baca bajana iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho aho yateguriwe mu gice c’imbere mu Ngoro, ari ho hitwa Ahera Cane, baca bayishira musi y’amababa ya ba bakerubi.
Abo bakerubi bari bashanje amababa hejuru y’aho iyo Sandugu yari iri, agapfuka Isandugu hamwe n’imyamba bayireruza.
Iyo myamba yari miremire ku buryo umuntu ari Ahera Cane yashobora kubona aho igarukira. Ariko umuntu atarashika Ahera, ntivyashoboka ko ayibona; kandi n’uwu musi ni ho ikiri.
Nta kindi kintu cari muri iyo sandugu kiretse vya bisate Mose yashiramwo ari i Horebu, aho Uhoraho yagiraniye isezerano n’Abisirayeli bamaze kuva muri Egiputa.
Abaherezi baca barasohoka bava Ahera. Abaherezi bari ngaho bose bari bihumanuye, hadakurikijwe imice yabo.

Abalewi bose bari abaririmvyi, Asafu, Hemani, Yedutuni n’abahungu babo n’ab’iwabo bose, barahaguruka bahagarara mu buseruko bw’igicaniro, bambaye impuzu zera derere bavuza ivyuma bisama, inanga n’amakembe. Bari baherekejwe n’abaherezi ijana na mirongo ibiri bavuza inzamba.

Abavuza inzamba n’abaririmvyi baririmba mw’ijwi rimwe, nk’umuntu umwe, mu guhimbaza bashimira Uhoraho . Baherekejwe n’inzamba, ivyuma bisama n’ibindi bicurarangisho, bashira amajwi hejuru bahimbaza Uhoraho baririmba bati: “Ni mwiza; urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.” Maze Ingoro y’ Uhoraho yuzura igicu c’ubwiza,
abaherezi ntibaba bagishobora gukora igikorwa cabo kubera ico gicu, kuko ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwari bwuzuye Ingoro y’Imana.

headings.text: Bazana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho mu Ngoro

verses.text: Maze Salomo avuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho , wavuze ko uba mu gicu c’umwijima w’umuzitanya.
Ariko jewe nakwubakiye Ingoro y’igitangaza, ikibanza uzokwiberamwo ibihe vyose.”
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli rigihagaze ngaho, umwami arahindukira arabahezagira.
Maze avuga ati: “ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli ahimbazwe, we ashikije n’amaboko yiwe ivyo yari yarasezeraniye data Dawidi n’akanwa kiwe, aho yavuga ati:

‘Uhereye umusi nakuriye ubwoko bwanje mu gihugu ca Egiputa, sinigeze ntoranya igisagara na kimwe co mu miryango ya Isirayeli ngo cubakwemwo Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, canke ngo ntoranye umuntu n’umwe ngo abe uwo kurongora ubwoko bwanje bw’Abisirayeli.
Ariko ubu ntoranije Yerusalemu ngo izina ryanje rihabe, kandi ntoranije Dawidi kugira ngo abe ari we aganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.’
Data Dawidi yari afise umugambi mu mutima wo kwubakira Ingoro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli;
ariko Uhoraho amubwira ati: ‘Wagize neza kwiyumvira kwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje,
ariko si wewe uzoyubaka. Umuhungu wawe, uwo wivyariye, ni we azokwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje.’

Uhoraho yazigamye isezerano ryiwe. Yansubije mu gishingo ca data Dawidi; none ubu nicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa Isirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabisezeranye, kandi nanje nubatse Ingoro yo guhesha icubahiro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli.
Aho ni ho nashize ya sandugu irimwo rya sezerano Uhoraho yagiranye n’ubwoko bw’Abisirayeli.”
Maze Salomo ahagarara imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho n’imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli agorora amaboko yiwe.

Salomo yari yarubatse hagati na hagati muri rwa rugo, ahantu hataramutse ho guhagarara mu butare bw’umwakaka, hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure n’ubwaguke, hakagira n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu z’igihagararo. Ahagararaho, araheza apfukama imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli agorora amaboko ayerekeje mw’ijuru.
Nuko aravuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho Mana ya Isirayeli, nta yindi Mana ihwanye nawe mw’ijuru no mw’isi, wewe uzigama isezerano wagiriye abasavyi bawe, bagukurikira n’imitima yabo yose.
Wazigamye isezerano wagiriye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe, urisezeranishije akanwa kawe, none uwu musi urishikishije amaboko yawe.

None rero Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, zigamira umusavyi wawe Dawidi ari we data, isezerano wamugiriye, aho wavuga uti: ‘Mu ruvyaro rwawe, ntihazokwigera habura uwuba ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, nirwagendera mu Vyagezwe vyanje nk’uko wabigendeyemwo.’
None rero Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, shitsa isezerano wasezeraniye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe.
Ariko none vy’ukuri Imana izoba hano kw’isi ibane n’abantu? Ko amajuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, udashobora kuyakwirwamwo, mbe ndareka iyi Ngoro nubatse!
Ariko wumvirize ugusenga n’ukwinginga kwanje, Uhoraho Mana yanje. Wumve ugutakamba n’ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe ari imbere yawe.
Inyonga zawe zize zame ziri kuri iyi Ngoro ku murango no mw’ijoro, aha hantu wavuze ko uzoshira izina ryawe. Uzokwame wumva amasengesho umusavyi wawe azosengera hano hantu.
Uze wumvirize ukwinginga kw’umusavyi wawe n’ukw’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli nibasenga batumbereye iyi ngoro. Uze ubumvirize uri mw’ijuru, aho uba; kandi niwabumva, ubaharire.
Umuntu niyagirira nabi mugenziwe maze bigasabwa ko bamurahiza ko atabikoze, akaza akarahirira imbere y’igicaniro cawe kiri muri iyi Ngoro,
uze uvyumve uri mw’ijuru ucire urubanza abantu bawe. Uwakoze ikibi atsindwe, ivyo yakoze bimusubire ku mutwe kandi hatsinde uwutacumuye, umwerekane kandi bimenyekane ko ata kimwagira.
Abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli nibatsindwa n’abansi babo kuko bagucumuyeko maze bagahindukira bagahimbaza izina ryawe, bagasenga binginga imbere yawe bari muri iyi Ngoro,
uzobumve uri mw’ijuru uharire icaha c’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli ubagarukane mu gihugu wabahaye bo na ba sekuruza.
Ijuru niryugarwa imvura ntigwe kuko abantu bawe bagucumuyeko, maze bagasenga batumbereye aha hantu bagahimbaza izina ryawe, bagahindukira bakava mu caha cabo, umaze kubateza ivyago,
uze ubumve uri mw’ijuru, uharire icaha c’abasavyi bawe, ari bo bwoko bwawe bw’Abisirayeli. Uze ubigishe inzira zawe, maze urekurire imvura mu gihugu wahaye abantu bawe kw’umugabane.

Ikigoyi canke ikiza nivyatera mu gihugu, canke akaranda canke ururyi, inzige canke ibihori, canke abansi babo bakabugariza mu gisagara kimwe mu vyo babamwo, ikiza ico ari co cose canke ingwara iyo ari yo yose nivyabashikako,
maze hakagira na bamwe bo mu Bisirayeli basenga ku bw’imibabaro yo mu mitima yabo, bakarabisha ibiganza vyabo kuri iyi Ngoro,
nawe uze wumve uri mw’ijuru, aho wibera. Uze ubaharire, kandi ugirire umuntu wese ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze, kuko uzi imitima yabo: ni wewe wenyene uzi imitima y’abana b’abantu.
Ni ho bazogutinya bakagendera mu nzira zawe ibihe vyose bazoba mu gihugu wahaye ba sogokuruza.

Mbere n’aho yoba umunyamahanga atari uwo mu bwoko bwawe bw’Abisirayeli, ariko akaza avuye mu gihugu ca kure ku bw’izina ryawe rihambaye n’ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi kandi kuramvuye; niyaza akagusenga atumbereye iyi Ngoro,

uze umwumve uri mw’ijuru, aho uba, ukorere uwo munyamahanga ico azoba agusavye cose, kugira ngo amahanga yose yo kw’isi amenye izina ryawe akwubahe, nk’uko abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli bakora, kandi bamenye ko iyi Ngoro nubatse yitirirwa izina ryawe.
Abantu bawe nibaja mu ntambara kugwanya abansi babo, aho uzobarungika hose, maze bakagusenga batumbereye iki gisagara watoranije n’iyi Ngoro nubakiye izina ryawe,
nuko uze wumve ugusenga kwabo no kwinginga kwabo uri mw’ijuru, ubatabare.

Nibaramuka bagucumuyeko, kuko ata muntu adacumura, hanyuma uburake bwawe bukabaziriringira, maze ukabarekurira mu maboko y’abansi babo bakabatwara nk’inyagano mu bihugu vyabo, vyaba ivya hafi canke ivya kure;

maze nibahindukira mu mitima yabo bari mu gihugu bajanywemwo nk’inyagano, bakihana bakagusaba imbabazi bari muri ico gihugu c’ababanyaze bakavuga bati: ‘twaracumuye, twakoze nabi, twakoze ivyo kwankwa urunuka’;

maze bakagaruka kuri wewe n’imitima yabo yose n’imishaha yabo yose, bari mu gihugu c’abansi babo babagize inyagano, hanyuma bagasenga baraba mu gihugu wahaye ba sekuruza babo, no ku gisagara watoranije hamwe no kuri iyi Ngoro nubakiye izina ryawe;
nuko uri mw’ijuru, aho uba, uze wumve ugusenga kwabo n’ugutakamba kwabo, uheze ubagwanirire. Uheze uharire abantu bawe, bagucumuyeko.
None rero, Mana yanje, inyonga zawe zame kuri aha hantu kandi amatwi yawe uyashire ku gusenga kwose kuzobera aha hantu.

Nuko rero haguruka, ewe Uhoraho Mana, uze mu buruhukiro bwawe, wewe n’Isandugu, ari co kimenyetso c’inkomezi zawe. Abaherezi bawe, yewe Uhoraho Mana, nibambare agakiza kawe, abizigirwa bawe banezererwe ukugira neza kwawe.
Yewe Uhoraho Mana, ntushiburire kure uwo warobanuje amavuta. Wibuke urukundo ruhambaye wasezeraniye Dawidi umusavyi wawe.”

headings.text: Salomo asenga isengesho ryo gushikiriza iyo Ngoro

verses.text: Salomo ahejeje gusenga, umuriro urakoroka uvuye mw’ijuru utongora ikimazi co guturirwa n’ibimazi vyose, maze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwuzura iyo Ngoro.
Abaherezi ntibashobora kwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kuko ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwari buyuzuye.

Abisirayeli bose babonye umuriro umanutse kandi ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho buri hejuru y’iyo Ngoro, bapfukama ku musezero, bubama hasi, basenga bashimira Uhoraho , bavuga bati: “Uri mwiza; urukundo rwawe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Nuko umwami n’abantu bose bashikanira ibimazi Uhoraho .
Umwami Salomo araheza atanga ikimazi kigizwe n’impfizi ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’intama ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri. Uko ni ko umwami n’abantu bose bashikirije Imana iyo Ngoro.

Abaherezi baja mu bibanza vyabo, n’Abalewi ni uko bafise ibicurarangisho vy’ Uhoraho , ivyo umwami Dawidi yari yarakoze vyo gutazira Uhoraho , vyakoreshejwe mu gutazira igihe yashima avuga ati: “Urukundo rwayo rwamaho ibihe bidashira.” Ku rundi ruhande rurabana n’aho Abalewi bari bari, hari abaherezi bavuza inzamba, Abisirayeli bose na bo bari bahagaze.

Maze umwami ashikiriza Uhoraho ikibanza kiri imbere y’Ingoro, ahatangira n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ifu hamwe n’ibinure vy’ibimazi vy’ishimwe, kuko igicaniro yari yarakoze mu butare bw’umwakaka kitashobora gukwirwako ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ifu hamwe n’ibinure vy’ibimazi.
Nuko umwami Salomo ari kumwe n’Abisirayeli bose bamara imisi indwi bagira imisi mikuru. Hari hakoraniye abantu isinzi bari baje bava i Lebo-Hamati gushika ku mugezi wa Egiputa.
Ku musi ugira umunani bagira ikoraniro ryo kurangiza, kuko bari bamaze imisi indwi bashikiriza Uhoraho igicaniro, bongera bamara imisi indwi bagira umusi mukuru w’insago.
Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na gatatu w’ukwezi kw’indwi arungika abantu iwabo, bataha banezerewe cane, imitima yabo inezerejwe n’ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye Dawidi na Salomo n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Nuko Salomo ahejeje Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba c’umwami, akarangiza neza n’ivyo yari yarateguye gukora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no ku kirimba ciwe bwite,
Uhoraho aramwiyereka mw’ijoro amubwira ati: “Numvise ugusenga kwawe kandi ntoranije aha hantu ngo habe ahanje, habe Ingoro yo gushikaniramwo ibimazi.
Ninugara ijuru ngo imvura ntigwe, canke nkarekura inzige ngo zirye imirima canke nkarekura ikiza mu bantu banje,
abantu banje, bitirirwa izina ryanje, nibicisha bugufi bagasenga barondera mu nyonga hanje, bakava mu nzira zabo mbi, nanje nzobumva ndi mw’ijuru, mparire ivyaha vyabo, nkize n’igihugu cabo.
Guhera ubu inyonga zanje zizokwama kuri bo n’amatwi yanje azokwama yumviriza amasengesho bazosengera aha hantu.
Ndobanuye iyi Ngoro kandi ndayitoranije kugira ngo izina ryanje rihabe ibihe bidashira. Amaso yanje n’umutima wanje bizokwama kuri yo.
Nawe niwagendera imbere yanje nk’uko so Dawidi yabigira, ugakora ivyo nagutegetse vyose, ugakurikiza amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje;
nanje nzokomeza intebe yawe y’ubwami, nk’uko nasezeraniye so Dawidi igihe navuga nti: ‘Ntuzokwigera ubura uwo kuganza Abisirayeli.’
Ariko nimwahindukira mugata amategeko n’amabwirizwa nabahaye, mukaja gukorera izindi mana mukazisenga,
nanje nzorandura Abisirayeli ndabakure mu gihugu canje nari narabahaye; n’iyi Ngoro neguriye izina ryanje nzoyita imve mu maso. Nzoyigira iciro ry’imigani n’agatwengo mu mahanga yose.
Kandi naho iyi Ngoro yari iteye igomwe, abazoyica i ruhande bazogira ubwoba batangare bavuge bati: ‘Ni igiki catumye Uhoraho agirira atya iki gihugu n’iyi Ngoro?’

Abantu bazobishura bati: ‘Ni ukubera bataye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza yabakuye muri Egiputa, bagahindukirira izindi mana, bakazisenga kandi bakazikorera; ni co gituma Uhoraho yabateje ivyo vyago vyose.’ ”
Haheze imyaka mirongo ibiri, ari yo Salomo yubatsemwo iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba ciwe,
Salomo asubiramwo kwubaka ibigwati Hiramu yari yamuhaye, aca avyimuriramwo Abisirayeli ngo babibemwo.
Maze Salomo aca aja gutera i Hamati Zoba arahafata.
Arongera asubiramwo kwubaka Tadumori mu bugaragwa, n’ibisagara vyose vy’ububiko yari yarubatse i Hamati.
Yubaka kandi ibisagara vya Beti-Horoni yo haruguru na Beti-Horoni yo hepfo abigira ibikomeye, bizitijwe inzitiro kandi bifise amarembo n’ibihindizo.
Arongera yubaka Bayalati n’ibisagara vy’ububiko vyiwe, n’ibisagara vyose vy’imikogote yiwe n’amafarasi yiwe; ivyo yipfuje vyose kwubaka i Yerusalemu, i Libani no mu gihugu cose aho yaganza.
Hari hakiriho amasigarira y’Abaheti, Abamori, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi; abo bo ntibari Abisirayeli.

Ni abasigaye, abo Abisirayeli batashoboye kurandura, bo mu moko yakomoka ku mahanga yahora aba muri ico gihugu. Nuko Salomo aca afata abo bantu bose abagira abagurano, abashinga gukora ibikorwa vy’agahato, nk’uko biri kugeza n’uwu musi.
Ariko Salomo nta Mwisirayeli n’umwe yagize umugurano ngo amukorere; ahubwo yabagize abo kugwana, intwazangabo, abagwanira ku mikogote, n’abakuru babo.
Umwami Salomo agena abatware amajana abiri na mirongo itanu bo gukurikirana abantu.

Salomo akura umukobwa wa Farawo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, amwimurira mu ngoro aho yari yamwubakiye, kuko yagize ati: “Umwamikazi wanje ntakwiye kuba mu ngoro ya Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli, kuko Isandugu y’ Uhoraho yigeze kuhaba kandi ahantu hose Isandugu y’Uhoraho yinjiye hakaba ari ahera.”
Ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho ico Salomo yari yarubakishije imbere y’ibaraza, ahashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa,

nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe na Mose ku vyerekeye ibimazi bishikanwa ku musi ku musi, ivyo ku masabato, ivyo mu mboneko z’ukwezi n’ivy’imisi mikuru itatu yo mu mwaka: umusi mukuru w’imikate itagiramwo umwambiro, umusi mukuru w’amayinga, n’umusi mukuru w’insago.

Mu bijanye no gushira abaherezi ku bikorwa vyabo, Salomo akurikiza ivyo se Dawidi yashinze. Kandi ashiraho n’Abalewi bo kurongora indirimbo zo gutazira no gufasha abaherezi nk’uko bisabwa ku musi ku musi. Ashiraho n’abarinzi b’amarembo nk’uko imice yabo yari iri ku marembo atandukanye, kuko ivyo ari vyo Dawidi umuntu w’Imana yari yarategetse.
Salomo ntiyakikamye ngo ave mu vyo umwami yashinze vyerekeye abaherezi canke Abalewi, harimwo mbere n’ivyerekeye ububiko.
Ico Salomo yategerezwa gukora cose carakozwe, kuva ku musi bashiriyeko umushinge w’ingoro y’ Uhoraho gushika bahejeje kuyubaka. Uko ni ko iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bahejeje kuyubaka.
Hanyuma Salomo aja i Eziyoni Geberi n’i Elati ku nkengera y’ikiyaga, ku rubibe rw’Abanyedomu.

Maze Hiramu amurungikira amato akoresheje abakozi biwe, abantu bari bazi neza ivy’ikiyaga. Abo rero, bari kumwe n’abantu ba Salomo, barasoza baja i Ofiru bakurayo italanto amajana ane na mirongo itanu z’inzahabu, bayashikiriza umwami Salomo.

Umwamikazi w’i Sheba yumvise ingene Salomo ari umuntu ahambaye, aja i Yerusalemu kumugerageresha ibibazo bigoye cane. Ashika ari kumwe n’abamuherekeje benshi, ingamiya zikoreye ibimota neza, inzahabu nyinshi cane, n’amabuye y’agaciro; maze aja aho Salomo ari aganira na we ivyo yiyumvira vyose.
Salomo yishura ibibazo vyose yamubajije, ntihagira na kimwe kimunanira kumusigurira.
Umwamikazi w’i Sheba abonye ubwenge bwa Salomo n’ingoro yubatse,

ivyokurya vyo ku meza yiwe, ivyicaro vy’abatware biwe, abakozi biwe bagabura ku meza n’imyambaro yabo, abamuhereza ivyo kunywa n’imyambaro yabo, n’ibimazi bituriwe yatanga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , aratangara cane.
Abarira umwami ati: “Ivyo numviye mu gihugu canje ku vyerekeye ivyo wakoze hamwe n’ubwenge bwawe, nsanze ari ukuri.
Ariko sinari navyizeye gushika nishikiye hano nkavyibonera n’amaso yanje ubwanje. Mu vy’ukuri, nta n’igice bambwiye c’ingene ubwenge bwawe bungana; birarengeye kure cane ivyo bambwiye.
Erega abantu bawe barahiriwe! Eka n’abagendanyi bawe na bo nyene barahiriwe, bo bama bahagaze imbere yawe imisi yose, bumviriza ivy’ubwenge bwawe!

Uhoraho Imana yawe iragahimbazwa, kuko wayihimbaye maze ikagushira ku ntebe yayo ngo uganze mw’izina ryayo. Ku bw’urukundo Imana yawe ikunda Abisirayeli n’ukugomba kubashigikira ibihe vyose, yakugize umwami ngo ubarongore, kandi ukomeze uguca imanza zibereye no kugororoka.”

Maze aca ashikanira umwami italanto ijana na mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu, ibimota neza vyinshi, n’amabuye y’igiciro. Nta n’umwe yongeye gushikanira umwami ibimota neza bingana n’ivyo umwamikazi w’i Sheba yashikaniye umwami Salomo.
I ruhande y’ivyo, abantu ba Hiramu n’abantu ba Salomo bazanye inzahabu zo muri Ofiru; bazana n’ibiti vyitwa santali n’amabuye y’igiciro kinini.
Umwami aca akoresha vya biti vya santali mu kwubaka ingazi z’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ingoro yiwe, yongera abikoramwo amakembe n’inanga vy’abacuraranzi. Nta bintu vyiza nk’ivyo vyari bwaboneke mu Buyuda.

Umwami Salomo aha umwamikazi w’i Sheba ivyo yipfuza n’ivyo yasavye vyose; amwihera n’izindi ngabire nk’uko umugenzo w’ubugwaneza bw’umwami Salomo wari uri. Maze arahaguruka asubira mu gihugu ciwe n’abari kumwe na we.
Ingabire Salomo yaronka ku mwaka ku mwaka zangana n’italanto amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu na zitandatu z’inzahabu,
udashizemwo ubundi butunzi yaronka biciye mu makori abadandaza batanga hamwe n’ayava mu bami bose bo muri Arabiya; abatware bo mu gihugu ciwe na bo bakama bamushikanira inzahabu n’ifeza.
Umwami Salomo acurisha inkinzo nininini amajana abiri mu nzahabu; imwimwe yose itwara shekeli amajana atandatu z’inzahabu.
Acurisha n’izindi nkinzo ntonto amajana atatu mu nzahabu, imwe yose ikajako shekeli amajana atatu z’inzahabu. Umwami aca azibika mu ngoro yise Ikibira c’i Libani.
Hanyuma umwami akoresha intebe y’ubwami nini isharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu ayomekako inzahabu ihinguwe neza.

Iyo ntebe yari ifise ingazi zitandatu, n’ico gushirako ibirenge c’inzahabu cari gifatanye na yo. Ku mpande zose z’iyo ntebe hari ivyo gushirako amaboko, kandi hari n’ibishushanyo vy’intare bibiri bihagaze i ruhande y’amaboko.
Hari n’ibindi bishushanyo cumi na bibiri vy’intare, kimwekimwe ku mpera y’ingazi yose muri zimwe zitandatu. Nta ntebe nk’iyo yari bwigere iboneka mu bwami na bumwe.

Ibikombe vyose vy’umwami Salomo vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu, n’ibikoresho vyose vyo mu ngoro yise Ikibira c’i Libani vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguwe neza. Nta na kimwe cari gikozwe mw’ifeza, kuko ifeza yafatwa nk’aho ifise agaciro gato mu gihe ca Salomo.

Umwami yari afise amato yo kudandaza yaja i Tarushishi atwawe n’abantu ba Hiramu. Uko imyaka itatu iheze ayo mato yaba agarutse avuye i Tarushishi, azanye inzahabu, ifeza, amahembe y’inzovu, inkende, n’amadendo.
Maze umwami Salomo aba agahambaye mu butunzi no mu bwenge kurusha abandi bami bose bo kw’isi.
Abami bose bo kw’isi bagomba kubonana na Salomo ngo bumve ubwenge Imana yamuhaye.
Ku mwaka ku mwaka, abaja kumuraba umwe wese yagenda amushikaniye ifeza n’inzahabu, amakanzu, ibigwanisho, ibimota neza, amafarasi, n’inyumbu.
Salomo yari afise ibibandahori ibihumbi bine vy’amafarasi n’imikogote, n’amafarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri. Zimwe yazitungira mu bisagara vy’imikogote, izindi zikaba i Yerusalemu aho yaba.
Yaganza abami bose uhereye ku ruzi Efurate mu buraruko hamwe n’igihugu c’Abafilisitiya, gushika ku rubibe rwa Egiputa mu bumanuko.
Umwami agwiza ifeza i Yerusalemu zisigara zimeze nk’amabuye, imbaho z’agaciro z’amasederi na zo ziragwira zimera nk’ibiti vy’imisukomora vyo mu biyaya vy’i Buyuda.
Amafarasi ya Salomo yava muri Egiputa no mu bindi bihugu vyose.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Salomo, uhereye ku ntango ugashitsa kw’iherezo, mbega vyose ntivyanditswe mu vyagenda biraba vyanditswe na Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana, mu vyavugishijwe na Ahiya w’i Shilo no mu vyeretswe Ido uwerekwa vyerekeye Yerobowamu mwene Nebati?
Salomo yabaye ku ngoma i Yerusalemu aganza Abisirayeli bose kumara imyaka mirongo ine.
Nuko Salomo arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza; ahambwa mu Gisagara ca se Dawidi. Maze umuhungu wiwe Rehobowamu amusubirira ku ngoma.

headings.text: Umwamikazi w’i Sheba aja kuramutsa Salomo

verses.text: Rehobowamu aja i Shekemu aho Abisirayeli bose bari bakoraniye kugira ngo bamwimike abe umwami.
Yerobowamu mwene Nebati avyumvise ari muri Egiputa, aho yari yarahungiye umwami Salomo, aca aragaruka.
Nuko batumako Yerobowamu, maze we n’Abisirayeli bose baja aho Rehobowamu ari bamubwira bati:
“So yadutwaje umukazo, none turagusavye utugabanirize umuruho w’ibikorwa bigoye yadutegetse gukora, natwe tuzoba abasavyi bawe.”
Rehobowamu abishura ati: “Muze mugaruke haciye imisi itatu.” Nuko abo bantu baca baragenda.
Umwami Rehobowamu aca agisha inama abatware bakoranye na se Salomo akiriho. Arababaza ati: “Mungiriye inama ki? Aba bantu ndabishure iki?”
Na bo baramwishura bati: “Niwagirira neza aba bantu ukabanezereza, ukabaha inyishu nziza, bazokwama bagukorera ibihe vyose.”
Ariko Rehobowamu yanka impanuro abahumure bamuhaye, aca asiguza abasore bakuranye na we bari mu bamukorera.
Arababaza ati: “Mumpanuye iki? Nokwishura iki aba bantu bambwiye bati: ‘Turemurure umutwaro so yaturemetse’?”

Ba basore bakuranye na we bamwishura bati: “Abo bantu bakubwiye bati, ‘So yaturemetse imitwaro ituvuna, ariko weho uturemurure iyo mitwaro’; babwire uti, ‘Urutoke rwanje rw’uruhererezi rusumvya ubunini umugongo wa data.
Data yabaremereje ibikorwa vyinshi, ni ko: ariko jeho nzobibaremereza gusumba. Data yabakubitisha ikimoko, jeho nzobarisha sikoropiyo!’ ”
Haheze imisi itatu, Yerobowamu na ba bantu bagaruka kuraba umwami Rehobowamu, nk’uko yari yabibabwiye, ati: “Muze mugaruke mu misi itatu.”
Maze umwami Rehobowamu abishura abakankamira, kuko yari yanse impanuro yahawe n’abahumure,
akumvira impanuro z’imisore yakuranye na we. Abishura ati: “Data yabaremereje ibikorwa bigoye, jeho nzobibaremereza gusumba. Data yabakubitisha ikimoko, jeho nzobarisha sikoropiyo.”
Nuko umwami ntiyumvira abo bantu, kuko Imana ari yo yatumye vyose bigenda gutyo, kugira ngo Uhoraho ashitse ico yari yarasezeraniye Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, abicishije kuri Ahiya w’i Shilo.

Abisirayeli bose babonye ko umwami yanse kubumviriza, bishura umwami bati: “Hari umugabane dufise mu muryango wa Dawidi? Nta co twiteze kuronka kuri mwene Isayi. Yemwe Bisirayeli, mwese nimusubire mu ngo zanyu. Nawe Dawidi, urimenya urabe ab’inzu yawe!” Nuko Abisirayeli bose basubira iwabo.
Ariko Abisirayeli bagumye baba mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, bobo Rehobowamu yagumye abaganza.

Umwami Rehobowamu arungika Hadoramu yari ajejwe ibikorwa vy’agahato, kugira ngo agarukane umutekano, ariko Abisirayeli bamutera amabuye arapfa. Maze umwami Rehobowamu, yurira umukogote wiwe arahunga aja i Yerusalemu.
Uko ni ko imiryango ya Isirayeli yo mu buraruko yanse kuganzwa n’inzu ya Dawidi gushika n’uwu musi.

Rehobowamu ashitse i Yerusalemu, akoranya Abayuda n’Ababenyamini, abatoranyamwo imisore ishobora kugwana ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani kugira ngo baje gutera Abisirayeli, bagarurire ubwami Rehobowamu.
Ariko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Shemaya umuntu w’Imana riti:
“Barira Rehobowamu mwene Salomo umwami w’i Buyuda n’Abisirayeli bari i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini, uti:

‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ntimuduge kugwanya abavukanyi banyu. Umwe wese muri mwebwe nasubire iwe, kuko ivyabaye vyose ari jewe nabigize.’ ” Nuko bumvira ijambo ry’ Uhoraho basubira inyuma bareka gutera Yerobowamu.
Rehobowamu aba i Yerusalemu, aca yubaka ibisagara vyo kugwanira igihugu c’i Buyuda ari vyo
Betelehemu, Etamu, Tekowa,
Beti-Zuri, Soko, Adulamu,
Gati, Maresha, Zifu,
Adorayimu, Lakishi, Azeka,
Zora, Ayaloni n’i Heburoni. Ivyo vyari ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini.
Akomeza uburyo bwo kubikingira yongera ashiraho n’abakuru b’ingabo muri vyo, n’ububiko bw’ivyokurya, amavuta ya elayo, n’umuvinyu.
Ashiramwo inkinzo n’amacumu muri ivyo bisagara vyose, abigira ibihambaye. Nuko i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini haguma musi y’ubutware bwiwe.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi bandi bari bakwiragiye mu ntara zose za Isirayeli bavayo baja ku ruhande rwiwe.
Abalewi baheba ibisagara vyabo n’uburagiro bwabo, baja kuba i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu kuko Yerobowamu n’abahungu biwe bari babankiye gukora igikorwa cabo c’ubuherezi bw’ Uhoraho .
Kandi ashiraho abaherezi biwe ngo bakorere mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, ngo bahereze ibimazi ibigirwamana vy’impene n’inka yari yakoresheje.
Abo mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli bashize imitima ku kurondera Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, bakurikira Abalewi baja i Yerusalemu ngo baje gushikanira Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza ibimazi.
Bakomeza ubwami bw’i Buyuda, bashigikira Rehobowamu mwene Salomo imyaka itatu, bagendera mu nzira za Dawidi na Salomo mu gihe ciwe.
Rehobowamu arongora Mahalati, yari umukobwa wa Yerimoti mwene Dawidi na Abihayili, umukobwa wa Eliyabu mwene Isayi.
Avyarana na we abahungu ari bo: Yewushi, Shemariya na Zahamu.
Hanyuma arongora Mayaka umukobwa wa Abusalomu, ari we bavyaranye Abiya, Atayi, Ziza na Shelomiti.

Rehobowamu akunda Mayaka umukobwa wa Abusalomu kurusha abandi bagore biwe bose n’incoreke ziwe. Bose na bose yari afise abagore icumi n’umunani n’incoreke mirongo itandatu; bavyarana abahungu mirongo ibiri n’umunani n’abakobwa mirongo itandatu.
Rehobowamu ashinga Abiya mwene Mayaka ngo abe umuganwa mukuru ku bavukanyi biwe, kugira ngo aze amwimike.
Akorana ubwenge mu gukwiragiza abandi bahungu biwe mu ntara zose z’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini, no muri vya bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro. Abaha ubutunzi bwinshi, abaronderera n’abagore benshi.
Ubwami bwa Rehobowamu bumaze gukomera akaba agahambaye, we n’Abisirayeli bose bari kumwe na we baheba Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .
Maze mu mwaka ugira gatanu umwami Rehobowamu ari ku ngoma, Shishaki umwami wa Egiputa atera i Yerusalemu kuko batabaye abizigirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho .

Aza azananye n’imikogote ibihumbi cumi na bibiri n’abagendera ku mafarasi ibihumbi mirongo itandatu, n’ingabo zigwanira hasi zitoharurika z’Abanyalibiya, Abasuki, n’Abanyetiyopiya baje bazananye bavuye muri Egiputa.
Yigarurira ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda, araza ashika n’i Yerusalemu.

Maze uwavugishwa n’Imana Shemaya aza kwa Rehobowamu n’abakuru bose b’i Buyuda bari bakoraniye i Yerusalemu kubera gutinya Shishaki, arababwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Kubera ko mwampevye, nanje ndabatanze mu maboko ya Shishaki.’ ”
Abakuru b’Abisirayeli n’umwami baca bicisha bugufi bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho aragororotse.”
Uhoraho abonye ko bicishije bugufi, arungika ijambo ryiwe kuri Shemaya ati: “Ko bicishije bugufi, sinzobica ariko nzobaha agahengwe. Uburake bwanje ntibuzosukwa kuri Yerusalemu biciye kuri Shishaki.
Ariko bazoba abagurano biwe, kugira ngo bamenye itandukaniro riri hagati yo kunkorera jewe no gukorera abami bo mw’isi.”

Maze Shishaki umwami wa Egiputa ateye i Yerusalemu, asahura ubutunzi bwose bwari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ubwari mu ngoro y’umwami. Atwara ibintu vyose, harimwo na za nkinzo z’inzahabu Salomo yari yaracurishije.
Nuko umwami Rehobowamu aca acurisha izindi nkinzo mu butare bw’umwakaka asubiriza zimwe za mbere, aca azizeza intwazangabo z’abacungera ku kirimba c’ingoro y’umwami.
Igihe cose umwami yagomba kwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , abacungera ku kirimba baca bajana na we bitwaje za nkinzo, mu nyuma bagaheza bakazisubiza mu cumba cazo.
Kubera ko Rehobowamu yicishije bugufi, uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwaramuvuyeko ntiyarandurwa rwose. Kandi mu vy’ukuri, hariho ivyiza vyari mu Buyuda.

Umwami Rehobowamu aba agakomeye cane i Yerusalemu abandanya kuganza. Yari afise imyaka mirongo ine n’umwe igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, hanyuma aganza imyaka cumi n’indwi, aba i Yerusalemu, igisagara Uhoraho yari yaratoranije mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli ngo ahashire izina ryiwe. Nyina yitwa Nayama; yari Umwamonikazi.
Akora ibibi kuko atari yashize umutima wiwe ku kurondera Uhoraho .

Ivyabaye ku ngoma ya Rehobowamu, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, mbega ntivyanditswe mu nzandiko z’ivyagenda biraba nk’uko vyanditswe na Shemaya uwavugishwa n’Imana hamwe na Ido uwerekwa, vyerekana ingene abantu bagiye bararondoka? Hama hari intambara hagati ya Rehobowamu na Yerobowamu.
Rehobowamu arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza; ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Maze umuhungu wiwe Abiya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yerobowamu ari ku ngoma, ni ho Abiya yaba umwami w’i Buyuda,
maze aganza imyaka itatu aba i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Mayaka, umukobwa wa Uriyeli w’i Gibeya. Havyuka intambara hagati ya Abiya na Yerobowamu.
Abiya aja mu ntambara afise ingabo ibihumbi amajana ane bashobora kugwana; maze Yerobowamu atonda urugamba ngo agwane na we ari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi amajana umunani bashoboye kugwana.
Abiya ahagarara ku musozi Zemarayimu, mu misozi y’Abefurayimu, maze aravuga ati: Yewe Yerobowamu namwe Bisirayeli mwese, munyumvirize!
Ntimuzi ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yimitse Dawidi ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli n’abamukomokako ibihe vyose biciye mw’isezerano ry’umunyu?
Ariko Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, umukozi wa Salomo mwene Dawidi, yagararije shebuja.

Bamwe mu bantu b’imburakimazi, batisonera, bagiye hamwe baja aho ari kugira ngo bagwanye Rehobowamu mwene Salomo igihe yari akiri muto ataramenya gufata ingingo, kandi atarakomera ngo agwanye izo mburakimazi.

“None rero mwateguye kugwanya ubwami bwashizweho n’ Uhoraho , buri mu minwe y’abakomoka kuri Dawidi. Egome muri ingabo nyinshi kandi muje mufise vya bigirwamana vy’inka bicuzwe mu nzahabu Yerobowamu yacurishije ngo bibe imana zanyu.

Ntimwirukanye abaherezi b’ Uhoraho , bene Aroni, n’Abalewi, mukishiriraho abaherezi banyu nk’uko bigenda no mu yandi mahanga? Umuntu wese aje azanye ishuri n’impfizi z’intama indwi muca mumugira umuherezi w’ibitari imana vy’ukuri.
Ariko tweho, Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu, kandi ntitwigeze tumuhemukira. Abaherezi bahereza Uhoraho ni bene Aroni, kandi Abalewi ni bo babafasha.

Uko bukeye uko bwije bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ibimota neza. Bama bategura ya mikate itambiwe kuri ya meza idahumanye kandi bagatunganya amatara ku giterekwako amatara c’inzahabu uko bukeye. Twama twitondera ivyo Uhoraho Imana yacu yihanikirije. Ariko mwebwe mwaramutaye.

Imana iri kumwe natwe; ni yo iturongora. Abaherezi bayo ni bo baza kuvuza inzamba y’akamo k’intambara nitwaza kubagwanya. Bagabo b’Abisirayeli, ntimugwanye Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza banyu, kuko mutazotsinda.”
Muri ico gihe Yerobowamu yari yarungitse ingabo zimwe ngo zibaturuke inyuma, ku buryo izindi ngabo zisigaye zari zihanganye n’Abayuda, abandi babaturutse inyuma.
Abayuda bahindukiye babona ko batewe imbere n’inyuma. Nuko baca batakambira Uhoraho . Abaherezi bavuza inzamba zabo,
ingabo z’Abayuda ziha akamo. Bamaze kwiha akamo, Imana ica ikinagiza Yerobowamu n’Abisirayeli bose imbere ya Abiya n’Abayuda.
Abisirayeli bahunga Abayuda, maze Imana ibagabura mu maboko yabo.
Abiya n’abantu biwe babicamwo benshi, ingabo ibihumbi amajana atanu z’Abisirayeli zigwa muri iyo ntambara.
Kuri uwo musi ingabo z’Abisirayeli ziraneshwa bikomeye. Abayuda batahana intsinzi kuko bifatanije n’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Abiya akinagiza Yerobowamu amunyaga ibisagara vy’i Beteli, Yeshana na Efuroni, hamwe n’utundi dutoduto tuhakikije.
Yerobowamu ntiyasubira kugira inkomezi mu gihe c’ingoma ya Abiya. Maze Uhoraho aramukubita arapfa.
Ariko Abiya we arushaho kuba umunyenkomezi. Arongora abagore icumi na bane avyara abahungu mirongo ibiri na babiri n’abakobwa icumi na batandatu.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Abiya, ivyo yakoze n’ivyo yavuze, vyanditswe mu nkuru zanditswe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Ido.
Hanyuma Abiya arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Asa amusubirira ku ngoma, kandi ku ngoma yiwe, igihugu kiba impore kumara imyaka icumi.
Asa akora ibigororotse n’ibibereye imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Akuraho ibicaniro vy’imana z’inyamahanga n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, amenagura n’inkingi z’amabuye, asitura n’ibishushanyo vya Ashera.
Ategeka Abayuda ngo barondere Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, no kwumvira ivyagezwe vyiwe n’amabwirizwa yiwe.
Akuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo mu mataba y’imisozi hamwe n’ibicaniro batuririramwo ibimota neza vyari mu bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda, maze igihugu kironka impore ku ngoma yiwe.
Yubaka ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda, kuko igihugu cari impore. Nta n’umwe yamugwanije muri iyo myaka yose, kuko Uhoraho yamuhaye impore.

Abwira Abayuda ati: “Nimuze twubake ibi bisagara, tubikikuze inzitiro, twubake n’iminara, dushireko amarembo n’ibihindizo. Igihugu kiracari icacu, kuko twarondeye Uhoraho Imana yacu; twaramurondeye na we aduha impore impande zose.” Nuko barubaka kandi baratunga baratunganirwa.

Asa yari afise ingabo zingana ibihumbi amajana atatu bava i Buyuda, bari bafise inkinzo nini n’amacumu, n’abandi ibihumbi amajana abiri na mirongo umunani bava i Bubenyamini, bitwaje inkinzo ntonto n’imiheto. Abo bose bari abahizi bazi kugwana.
Zera Umunyetiyopiya aza kubatera afise ingabo zingana umuliyoni n’imikogote amajana atatu, araza ashika i Maresha.
Asa aja guhura na we, batonda urugamba mu kiyaya c’i Zefata hafi y’i Maresha.

Maze Asa yambaza Uhoraho Imana yiwe avuga ati: “ Uhoraho , nta n’umwe ameze nkawe wo gufasha abanyantegenke batewe n’abanyenkomezi. Dutabare, ewe Uhoraho Mana yacu, kuko tukwizigiye, kandi twaje kugwanya izi ngabo nyinshi gutya mw’izina ryawe. Ewe Uhoraho , ni wewe Mana yacu; ntureke ngo umuntu aguhonyore ku gakanu.”
Uhoraho atsinda Abanyetiyopiya imbere ya Asa n’Abayuda. Abo Banyetiyopiya barahunga,

Asa na we n’ingabo ziwe barabakurikira gushika i Gerari. Abenshi mu Banyetiyopiya bagwa mu ntambara ku buryo batasubiriye kuvyura umutwe, kuko bari batsinzwe imbere y’ Uhoraho n’ingabo ziwe. Ingabo z’Abayuda zisahura ibintu vyinshi muri ivyo bisagara.
Basambura ibisagara bitobito vyose bikikuje Gerari, kuko ubwoba buvuye k’ Uhoraho bwari bwabatekeye. Banyaga ivyo bisagara vyose, kuko harimwo ubutunzi bwinshi.
Batera aho abungere bacumbika batwara imikuku myinshi y’intama n’impene hamwe n’ingamiya. Basubira i Yerusalemu.
Mpwemu w’Imana aza kuri Azariya mwene Odedi.

Aja guhura na Asa aramubwira ati: “Nyumviriza, yewe Asa namwe Bayuda n’Ababenyamini mwese. Uhoraho azobana namwe nimwagumana na we. Nimwamurondera, muzomubona, ariko nimwamutera ibitugu, na we azobaheba.
Abisirayeli bamaze igihe kirekire batagira Imana y’ukuri, batagira umuherezi wo kubigisha batagira n’Ivyagezwe.
Ariko mu mubabaro wabo bahindukirira Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, baramurondera, baramubona.
Muri iyo misi nta mutekano wariho ku buryo abantu bashobora gutembera, kuko ababa mu gihugu bose bari mu muvurungano ukomeye.
Ihanga rimwe ryarazimanganya irindi, igisagara kimwe kikazimanganya ikindi, kuko Imana yari yabateje ivyago vy’ubwoko bwose.
Ariko mweho, nimukomere ntimwihebure, kuko igikorwa canyu kizoronka ingero.”

Asa yumvise ayo majambo n’ukuvugishwa kwa Azariya mwene Odedi uwavugishwa n’Imana, ararema. Akuraho ibigirwamana biteye isoni vyari mu gihugu cose c’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini no mu bisagara vyose yari yigaruriye mu misozi y’Abefurayimu. Asanasana igicaniro c’ Uhoraho cari imbere y’urwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Hanyuma akoranya Abayuda n’Ababenyamini bose n’abantu bose bo mu Bwefurayimu, Abamanase n’Abasimeyoni bari bimukiye muri bo, kuko abantu benshi bari baje kuri we bavuye mu Bisirayeli bamaze kubona ko Uhoraho Imana yiwe ari kumwe na we.
Bakoranira i Yerusalemu mu kwezi kwa gatatu kw’umwaka wa cumi na gatanu Asa ari ku ngoma.
Muri ico gihe bashikanira ibimazi Uhoraho bingana n’inka amajana indwi n’intama n’impene ibihumbi indwi bakuye mu vyo banyaze batahanye bavuye kugwana.
Bagira isezerano ryo kurondera Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, n’imitima yabo yose n’imishaha yabo yose.
Basezerana ko abatazorondera Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, bakwiye kwicwa, baba abakiri bato canke abakuze, abagabo canke abagore.
Basezeranira Uhoraho mu kwiha akamo, bavuza n’inzamba n’amahembe y’intama.
Abayuda bose bifatanya na bo muri iyo ndahiro kuko bari barahiye n’umutima ubikunze. Barondeye Imana n’imitima ibikunze, na yo irabiyereka. Nuko Uhoraho abaha impore impande zose.

Umwami Asa yirukana inakuru Mayaka, amwaka iteka ryo kuba nyina w’umwami, kuko yari yaracurishije igishushanyo c’ubuyobe ca Ashera. Asa atemagura ico kigirwamana akigira ubunywenywe; agituririra ku mwonga Kidironi.
Naho atashoboye gukura muri Isirayeli ibibanza vyose basengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi, umutima wiwe wamye utunganye imisi yose y’ukubaho kwiwe.
Yinjiza mu Ngoro y’Imana ifeza n’inzahabu n’ibikoresho we na se bari bareguriye Uhoraho .
Nta ntambara yasubiye kuba gushika ku mwaka wa mirongo itanu na gatanu wo ku ngoma ya Asa.

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu na gatandatu Asa ari ku ngoma, Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli aduga gutera i Buyuda, yubaka uruzitiro rukikuza i Rama kugira ngo abuze umuntu wese yogomba kuja canke kuva kwa Asa umwami w’i Buyuda.
Maze Asa afata ifeza n’inzahabu zari mu bubiko bwo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no mu ngoro yiwe azirungikira Beni-Hadadi umwami w’i Siriya, yatwarira i Damasiko, amurungikira n’ubutumwa buvuga ngo:

“Tugiriranire isezerano hagati yanje nawe, nk’uko vyari biri hagati ya data na so. Raba, ndakurungikiye ifeza n’inzahabu. None rero n’ureke isezerano rya mwe na Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli kugira ngo asubire inyuma areke kuntera.”
Beni-Hadadi yemeranya n’umwami Asa, arungika intwazangabo ziwe gutera ibisagara vya Isirayeli, bafata Iyoni, Dani, Abeli-Mayimu, bafata n’ibisagara vyose vy’ububiko vyo mu ntara ya Nafutali.
Bayasha avyumvise, aca areka kwubaka i Rama, ahagarika n’ivyo yariko arakora.
Maze umwami Asa azana abantu biwe b’i Buyuda bose, bakurayo amabuye n’imbaho zose Bayasha yariko azitiza igisagara ca Rama. Asa aca abikoresha mu kuzitira ibisagara vya Geba na Misipa.
Muri ico gihe Hanani uwerekwa aza ku mwami Asa w’i Buyuda amubwira ati: “Ko wishimiye umwami w’i Siriya ntiwizigire Uhoraho Imana yawe, ingabo z’umwami w’i Siriya ziraguciye mu myanya y’intoke.
Mbega Abanyetiyopiya n’Abanyalibiya ntibari ingabo zikomeye kandi zifise imikogote myinshi n’abagwanira ku mafarasi isinzi? Ariko igihe wizigira Uhoraho , yabagabuye mu maboko yawe.
Kuko inyonga z’ Uhoraho zinyurangana mw’isi yose ngo ahe inkomezi abamwegamitseko imitima yabo yose. Wakoze ivy’ubupfu, kandi guhera ubu uzokwama mu ntambara.”

Asa ashavurira uwo yerekwa kubera ivyo; arashangashirwa gushika aho amuta mw’ibohero, ashira amaguru yiwe mu mpatane z’ivyuma. Kandi muri ico gihe nyene Asa atangura gutwaza umukazo abantu bamwebamwe bo mu gihugu ciwe.
Ivyabaye ku ngoma ya Asa, kuva ku ntango kugeza ku mpera, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda n’abo muri Isirayeli.

Mu mwaka wa mirongo itatu n’icenda Asa ari ku ngoma asinzikazwa cane n’ingwara y’ibirenge. Naho iyo ngwara yari imubabaje cane, mu kugwara kwiwe kwose ntiyigeze arondera Uhoraho ngo amufashe, ariko yishimiye abavuzi.
Maze mu mwaka ugira mirongo ine na rimwe ari ku ngoma, Asa arapfa, ahamvya ba sekuruza.
Bamuhamba mu mva yari yarimbishije ubwiwe mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Bamuryamika ku buriri bari bashizeko ibimota neza vy’uburyo bwinshi, baca bacana umuriro mwinshi ngo bamuheshe icubahiro.
Yehoshafati umuhungu wiwe aca aba umwami amusubirira ku ntebe, maze akomeza Ubuyuda kugira ngo bashobore guhangana na Isirayeli.
Ashira ingabo mu bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro, ashiraho n’ibirindiro bikomeye mu Buyuda hose no mu bisagara vy’Abefurayimu, ivyo se Asa yari yarigaruriye.
Uhoraho yari kumwe na Yehoshafati kuko mu myaka yiwe ya mbere yagendeye mu nzira sekuruza Dawidi yari yaragendeyemwo. Ntiyasiguje za Bayali,
ahubwo yarondeye Uhoraho Imana ya se, agendera mu vyo yihanikirije, ntiyakora nk’ivyo Abisirayeli bakora.
Uhoraho aha ubwami bwiwe gukomera; kandi Abayuda bose bazanira ingabire Yehoshafati, gushika aho yabaye umutunzi, agira n’icubahiro.
Umutima wiwe warondera inzira z’ Uhoraho ; kandi akuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo mu mataba y’imisozi n’inkingi za Ashera mu Buyuda.
Mu mwaka ugira gatatu ari ku ngoma atuma abakuru bo mu bamukorera ari bo Beni-Hayili, Obadiya, Zakariya, Netaneli na Mikaya, ngo bigishe mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda.
Abarungikana n’Abalewi bamwe nka Shemaya, Netaniya, Zebadiya, Asaheli, Shemiramoti, Yehonatani, Adoniya, Tobiya na Tobi-Adoniya, n’abaherezi ari bo Elishama na Yehoramu.
Bigisha mu Buyuda hose, bitwaje Igitabu c’Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ; bazunguruka hose mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda bigisha abantu.
Ubwoba buvuye k’ Uhoraho bufata abami bose b’ibihugu bikikije Ubuyuda, ntibigera bubahuka gutera Yehoshafati.
Abafilisitiya bamwe bazanira Yehoshafati amashikanwa yo kumwisaba hamwe n’ifeza, n’Abarabu bamuzanira imikuku: impfizi z’intama ibihumbi indwi n’amajana indwi n’impene ibihumbi indwi n’amajana indwi.
Yehoshafati arushaho kuba uwukomeye; yubaka iminara n’ibisagara vy’ububiko mu Buyuda.
Yari afise ibintu vyinshi yabitse mu bisagara binini vy’i Buyuda, ashira i Yerusalemu ingabo zimenyereye ivyo kugwana.
Uku ni ko bari barinjiye mu ngabo bakurikije uko imiryango yabo yari iri: Mu Bayuda, hari abakuru batwara ingabo igihumbi: Adina umukuru w’ingabo, yari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi amajana atatu;
uwakurikira, ni Yehohanani umukuru w’ingabo, yari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi amajana abiri na mirongo umunani;
hagakurikira Amaziya mwene Zikuri, yitangiye igikorwa c’ Uhoraho , yari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi amajana abiri.
Mu Babenyamini: Eliyada, umusoda w’umuhizi, yari kumwe n’abagabo bitwaje imiheto n’inkinzo ibihumbi amajana abiri;
hagakurikira Yehozabadi, yari kumwe n’ingabo zambaye ibigwanisho vy’intambara ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani.
Abo ni bo bari ingabo zakorera umwami, uretse abo yari yararungitse muri vya bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro vyari mu gihugu cose c’i Buyuda.
Muri ico gihe Yehoshafati yari afise itunga ryinshi n’icubahiro cinshi, maze yifatanya na Ahabu biciye mu gusabira umuhungu wiwe umukobwa wa Ahabu.
Haheze imyaka mikeya, Yehoshafati amanuka i Samariya kuramutsa Ahabu. Maze Ahabu abagira Yehoshafati n’abo bari kumwe intama nyinshi n’inka nyinshi, aca amusaba ngo bajane gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi.

Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli abaza Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda ati: “Mbega wojana nanje kugwanya ab’i Ramoti Gileyadi?” Yehoshafati amwishura ati: “Twe nawe turi bamwe, kandi abantu banje ni abawe; turifatanya namwe muri iyo ntambara.”
Ariko Yehoshafati yongerako abwira umwami w’Abisirayeli ati: “Reka tubanze tugishe inama Uhoraho .”

Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli akoranya abavugishwa; bose hamwe bari abagabo amajana ane. Araheza ababaza ati: “Mbega mubona twoja gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi, canke tureke?” Barishura bati: “Nimugende, kuko Imana izohatanga mu kuboko kwawe mwami.”
Ariko Yehoshafati arabaza ati: “Mbega ngaha nta muvugishwa w’ Uhoraho n’umwe akihari twobaza?”

Umwami w’Abisirayeli yishura Yehoshafati ati: “Haracariho uwundi muvugishwa umwe yotubariza Uhoraho , ariko ndamwanka kuko atigera avugishwa ivyiza kuri jewe, atari ibibi. Ni Mikaya mwene Imula.” Yehoshafati aramwishura ati: “Umwami ntakwiye kuvuga atyo.”
Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli ahamagara umwe mu batware biwe amubwira ati: “Nyaruka uzane Mikaya mwene Imula.”

Ahabu umwami w’Abisirayeli na Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda, bari bambaye amakanzu yabo y’inyambarabami, bicara ku ntebe z’ubwami ku mbuga yo gusekurirako ingano iri kw’irembo ry’i Samariya, abavugishwa bavugishirizwa imbere yabo.
Maze Zedekiya mwene Kenayana yari yarakoze amahembe y’icuma, aca avuga ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Aya ni yo uzokwicisha Abasiriya gushika ubaranduye.’ ”
Abandi bavugishwa bose na bo nyene bavugishwa ukwo nyene, bati: “Genda utere i Ramoti Gileyadi, uzohatsinda, kuko Uhoraho azohatanga mu maboko y’umwami.”

Ya ntumwa yari yagiye guhamagara Mikaya iramubwira iti: “Raba abandi bavugishwa bose bahurije hamwe nk’umuntu umwe mu kuvugishwa intsinzi y’umwami. Ijambo ryawe rero rize kumera nk’iryabo, uvuge ivyiza.”
Ariko Mikaya amwishura ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , ico Imana imbwira ni co nja kuvuga.”
Ashitse, umwami aramubaza ati: “Mikaya, mbega tuje gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi, canke tureke?” Aramwishura ati: “Genda uhatere kandi uzotsinda, kuko hazotangwa mu maboko yawe.”
Umwami aca amubwira ati: “Nzogeza ryari kukurahiza kugira ngo ntihagire ikindi umbwira atari ukuri mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ?”

Mikaya amwishura ati: “Mu kwerekwa nabonye Abisirayeli bashwiragiye ku misozi nk’intama zitagira umwungere, Uhoraho aca ambarira ati: ‘Abo bantu ntibagira shebuja. Barungike umwe wese atahe mu rugo rwiwe amahoro.’ ”
Umwami w’Abisirayeli abarira Yehoshafati ati: “Sinakubwiye ko atigera avugishwa iciza na kimwe kuri jewe, atari ibibi gusa?”
Mikaya arabandanya ati: “Nuko niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho : Nabonye Uhoraho avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami ari kumwe n’ingabo zo mw’ijuru zihagaze i buryo n’i bubamfu bwiwe.
Maze Uhoraho avuga ati: ‘Ni nde yokwosha Ahabu umwami w’Abisirayeli ngo aje gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi kugira ngo aze yicirweyo?’ Umwe akavuga ibi, uwundi ibindi.
Mu nyuma ni ho haza impwemu ihagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho , imubwira iti: ‘Jewe nomwosha!’ Uhoraho ayibaza ati: ‘Uzobikora gute?’
Na yo yishura iti: ‘Nzosohoka mbe impwemu yo kubesha mu kanwa k’abavugishwa biwe bose.’ Uhoraho ayibwira ati: ‘Ni vyo, uzoshobora kumwosha! Genda ubikore.’
None rero, ehe raba Uhoraho yashize impwemu yo kubesha mu kanwa k’abavugishwa bawe, kuko yamaze gufata ingingo yo kugusukako ivyago.”
Nuko Zedekiya mwene Kenayana ava hasi akubita ikofe Mikaya. Amubaza ati: “Iyo mpwemu y’ Uhoraho yaciye mu yihe nzira iva kuri jewe iza kuvugana nawe?”
Mikaya amwishura ati: “Uzobimenya umusi uzobura aho winyegeza, ukajarajara uva mu cumba kimwe uja mu kindi.”
Umwami w’Abisirayeli atanga itegeko ati: “Nimumufate, mumujane kwa Amoni umukuru w’igisagara no kwa Yowashi umwana w’umwami.
Mubabwire muti: ‘Umwami avuze ngo: Uyu mugabo nimumushire mw’ibohero, ntihagire ikindi mumugaburira atari umukate n’amazi vy’inticantikize, gushika aho nzogarukira amahoro mvuye ku rugamba.’ ”
Mikaya na we aca avuga ati: “Niwagaruka amahoro, nzoba ntavugishijwe n’ Uhoraho !” Yongera abwira abari ngaho ati: “Yemwe bantu mwese, muraba muvyumvise!”
Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli na Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda baraduga baja gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi.
Umwami wa Isirayeli abarira Yehoshafati ati: “Nja kwinjira mu rugamba niyoberanije, ariko wewe ugume wambaye impuzu zawe z’inyambarabami.” Nuko umwami wa Isirayeli ariyoberanya baja ku rugamba.
Umwami w’i Siriya ategeka abarongora abagwanira ku mikogote yiwe mirongo itatu na babiri ati: “Ntihagire uwundi muntu n’umwe mutera, yaba muto canke mukuru, atari umwami w’Abisirayeli.”

Ba bakuru b’abagwanira ku mikogote babonye Yehoshafati, baribwira bati: “Nta gukeka, uwu ni we mwami w’Abisirayeli.” Nuko barahindukira ngo bamutere, ariko Yehoshafati arataka, Uhoraho aramutabara. Imana ibigiza kure yiwe,
kuko aho abatwara umukogote baboneye ko atari umwami w’Abisirayeli, baciye bareka kumukurikira.

Ariko umuntu umwe afora umuheto apfa kurasa, aca agema umwami w’Abisirayeli aho ivyuma bimukingira bihurira. Umwami aca abwira uwatwara umukogote wiwe ati: “Hindukira unkure mu rugamba, ndakomeretse.”

Ariko kuri uwo musi, urugamba rurushiriza gukomera, maze umwami w’Abisirayeli bapfa kumushigikirira aho nyene mu mukogote, aguma ameze nk’uwuhanganye n’Abasiriya kugeza ku mugoroba; maze nko ku kirengazuba aracikana.
Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda atahutse amahoro ku kirimba iwe i Yerusalemu,
Yehu uwerekwa, mwene Hanani, aja kumusanganira, aca amubwira ati: “Mbega vyari bikwiye ko uja gutabara urya muntu mubi ugakunda abansi b’ Uhoraho ? Kubera ivyo, wihamagariye uburake bw’ Uhoraho .
Ariko, hariho iciza kiri muri wewe, kuko wakuye inkingi za Ashera mu gihugu kandi ugashira umutima wawe ku kurondera Imana.”
Yehoshafati aba i Yerusalemu, maze aragenda aja mu bantu baba i Berisheba mu misozi y’Abefurayimu abagarukana k’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Ashiraho abacamanza mu gihugu, mu bisagara vyose bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda.
Ababwira ati: “Mumenye neza ivyo mukora, kuko mutariko mucira imanza abantu gusa, ariko muzica ku bw’ Uhoraho , kandi ari kumwe namwe igihe muzica.
Nuko rero nimwubahe Uhoraho . Mwitonde mu guca imanza, kuko k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu nta kurenganya canke guca iza ngondagonde, canke kurya ibiturire.”
N’i Yerusalemu na ho nyene, Yehoshafati ashinga bamwe mu Balewi, abaherezi n’abakuru bo mu miryango y’Abisirayeli, ngo bakoreshe ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho mu gutatura amatati; kandi baba i Yerusalemu.
Abaha aya mategeko ati: “Muze mukore mu bwizigirwa n’imitima yanyu yose, mwubaha Uhoraho .

Mu manza zose abavukanyi banyu b’Abisirayeli baba mu bisagara bazobazanira, zaba ari iz’amaraso canke ibindi bijanye n’ivyagezwe, amabwirizwa, amategeko n’ivyashinzwe, muze mubabwire ko badakwiye gucumura k’ Uhoraho ; bitari uko uburake bwiwe buzobazako mwebwe n’abavukanyi banyu. Muze mukore mutyo kugira ngo ntimucumure.

Amariya umuherezi mukuru ni we azobarongora mu bintu vyose vyerekeye Uhoraho . Zebadiya mwene Ishimayeli, umukuru w’umuryango wa Yuda, ni we azobarongora mu vyerekeye intwaro. Abalewi na bo bazoba abaraba ko ubutungane busasagaye. Mukorane umwete, kandi Uhoraho aze abane n’abazokora neza.”
Inyuma y’ivyo, Abanyamowabu n’Abamoni hamwe n’ab’i Mayoni bamwe, baja gutera Yehoshafati.
Haza abantu babwira Yehoshafati bati: “Ingabo nyinshi ziraje kugutera zivuye muri Edomu, hakurya y’Ikiyaga c’Umunyu. Kandi bamaze gushika i Hazazoni-Tamari” ari ho Eni-Gedi.
Yehoshafati aratinya, aca ahitamwo gusiguza Uhoraho , kandi ategeka ko Abayuda bose bisonzesha.
Abantu b’i Buyuda bakoranira hamwe ngo barondere Uhoraho ; kandi bari bavuye mu bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda baje kurondera Uhoraho .
Maze Yehoshafati ahagarara mw’ikoraniro ry’Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , imbere y’imbuga nshasha,

avuga ati: “Yewe Uhoraho Mana ya ba sogokuruza, mbega si wewe Mana yo mw’ijuru? Uganza ubwami bwose n’amahanga yose. Ubushobozi n’inkomezi biri mu kiganza cawe, kandi nta woshobora kuguhagarara imbere ngo muhangane.
Yewe Mana yacu, mbega ntiwirukanye ababa muri iki gihugu imbere y’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli ukagiha uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu umukunzi wawe?
Barakibayemwo kandi bacubakamwo Ingoro yitirirwa Izina ryawe bavuga bati:

‘Icago nicadutera, yaba inkota yo kuducira urubanza, canke akaranda, canke ikigoyi, tuzohagarara imbere yawe imbere y’iyi Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryawe, maze tugutakambire mu ngorane zacu, nawe uzotwumva udukize.’
None hariho abantu bavuye mu Bamoni, i Mowabu no ku musozi Seyiri, aho wankiye Abisirayeli ko bahatera igihe bava muri Egiputa; maze bica bituma bakevya ngo ntibabahonye.
Ariko raba ivyo batwishuye. Baje kudusohora ahantu waduhaye ngo habe inyegu yacu.
Ewe Mana yacu, mbega ntiwobacira urubanza? Kuko tudafise ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’iryo sinzi ry’ingabo zije kudutera. Ntituzi ico twokora, ariko amaso yacu tuyahanze wewe.”
Abayuda bose, abagore babo n’abana babo, abakuru n’abato, bahagarara ngaho imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Nuko Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri umwe mu bari muri iryo koraniro. Izina ryiwe ni Yahaziyeli mwene Zakariya, Zakariya wa Benaya, Benaya wa Yeyiyeli, Yeyiyeli wa Mataniya, Umulewi akomoka kuri Asafu.

Avuga ati: “Nimwumve, mwami Yehoshafati namwe ababa i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu mwese! Uku ni ko Uhoraho ababwiye: ‘Ntimutinye canke ngo mwihebure kubera izo ngabo nyinshi. Kuko intambara si iyanyu, ni iy’Imana.
Ejo muze mumanuke mubategere. Bazoba bariko baraduga baciye ku kadugo k’i Zizi, namwe muzobasanga bari aho ikiyaya kigarukira, mu bugaragwa bw’i Yeruweli.

Ntimuzorinda kugwana iyi ntambara. Muze mutonde urugamba muhagarare ku ruhande rwanyu; mushikame kugira ngo murabe ugutabarwa Uhoraho azobaha, mwebwe Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu. Ntimutinye, ntimwihebure. Ejo muze musohoke muhangane na bo; kandi Uhoraho azoba ari kumwe namwe.’ ”
Yehoshafati arunama ashika hasi, kandi n’Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu barunama imbere y’ Uhoraho , baramusenga.
Maze Abalewi bamwe bo mu Bakohati no mu Bakorahi barahaguruka, bahimbaza Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli n’ijwi rirenga.

Mu gitondo kare, baragenda batumbereye ubugaragwa bw’i Tekowa. Bagisohoka, Yehoshafati arahagarara avuga ati: “Nimunyumvirize, yemwe Bayuda namwe ababa i Yerusalemu! Nimwizere Uhoraho Imana yanyu muzohagarara mushikamye; nimwizigire abavugishwa na we muzoronka intsinzi.”

Amaze kubonana n’abantu, Yehoshafati aca ashiraho abantu bo kuririmbira Uhoraho no guhimbaza ubwiza bw’ukwera kwiwe, bagenda bararirimba bari imbere y’ingabo bavuga bati: “Nimushimire Uhoraho , kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Bagitangura kuririmba no guhimbaza, Uhoraho atega imitego ba Bamoni n’Abanyamowabu n’abo mu misozi y’i Seyiri bari baje gutera i Buyuda baca baratsindwa.
Abamoni n’Abanyamowabu bava hasi bagwanya abo mu misozi y’i Seyiri ngo babice babamare. Bahejeje kwicisha inkota ab’i Seyiri, baca barasubiranamwo, baricana.
Abayuda bashitse aho umuntu abona neza mu bugaragwa, baravye za ngabo nyinshi, babona ni ibiziga birambaraye hasi gusa; ata n’umwe yarokotse.

Nuko Yehoshafati n’abantu biwe baja gusahura ivyo bari bafise, basangamwo ibigwanisho vyinshi n’impuzu n’ibindi bikoresho vy’igiciro; biba vyinshi ku buryo batashobora kubitwarira rimwe. Kubera ko vyari vyinshi cane, bamaze imisi itatu yose bavyegeranya.
Ku musi ugira kane bakoranira mu kiyaya c’i Beraka, bahimbaza Uhoraho . Ni co gituma citwa ikiyaya c’i Beraka gushika uwu musi.
Maze Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu, barongowe na Yehoshafati, basubira i Yerusalemu banezerewe, kuko Uhoraho yari yabahaye kwitamba hejuru abansi babo.
Binjira i Yerusalemu, baja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bavuza inanga n’amakembe n’inzamba.
Ubwoba buvuye ku Mana bufata ubwami n’ibihugu bibakikuje, bamaze kwumva ingene Uhoraho yagwanije abansi b’Abisirayeli.
Maze ubwami bwa Yehoshafati buba amahoro, kuko Imana yiwe yari yamuhaye impore ku mpande zose.

Nuko Yehoshafati aganza i Buyuda. Yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda, maze aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Azuba umukobwa wa Shiluhi.
Agendera mu nzira za se Asa, kandi ntiyakikama ngo azivemwo; akora ibigororotse mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Ariko ntiyakuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ibigirwamana biri ku mataba y’imisozi, kandi abantu ntibari bwashire imitima yabo ku Mana ya ba sekuruza.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehoshafati, uhereye ku ntango ugashika ku mpera, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyagenda biraba canditswe na Yehu mwene Hanani, bikaba biri no mu gitabu c’abami ba Isirayeli.
Mu nyuma Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda agirana isezerano na Ahaziya umwami w’Abisirayeli, kandi uwo yari umwami mubi.
Yemeranya na we ngo bubake amato yo kuja i Tarushishi kuzana ibidandazwa. Bamaze kwubaka i Eziyoni Geberi,

Eliyezeri mwene Dodavahu w’i Maresha avugishwa aburira Yehoshafati, avuga ati: “Ko wagiriraniye isezerano na Ahaziya, Uhoraho azosambura ivyo wubatse.” Ayo mato aca arameneka ntiyashobora kuja i Tarushishi.
Maze Yehoshafati arapfa, ahamvya ba sekuruza; ahambwa mu Gisagara ca sekuruza Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Yehoramu amusubirira ku ngoma.
Abavukanyi ba Yehoramu, bene Yehoshafati, bari Azariya, Yehiyeli, Zakariya, Azariyahu, Mikayeli na Shefatiya. Abo bose bari bene Yehoshafati umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Se yari yarabagabiye ibintu vyinshi bigizwe n’ifeza n’inzahabu n’ibikoresho vy’agaciro; abaha n’ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda. Ariko yari yahaye Yehoramu ubwami kuko yari imfura yiwe.
Yehoramu amaze kwigira agakomeye ku bwami bwari ubwa se, yicisha inkota abo bavukana bose hamwe n’indongozi zose z’Abisirayeli.
Yehoramu yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n’ibiri igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami. Amara imyaka umunani aganza ari i Yerusalemu.
Agendera mu ngeso z’abami b’Abisirayeli, nk’uko ab’inzu ya Ahabu bakora, kuko yarongoye umukobwa wa Ahabu. Akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Ariko kubera isezerano Uhoraho yari yaragiraniye na Dawidi, Uhoraho ntiyashaka guherengeteza umuryango wa Yuda. Yari yarasezeranye kugumizaho itara ryiwe n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose.
Mu gihe Yehoramu yari ku ngoma, Abanyedomu bagarariza Abayuda, biyimikira umwami wabo.
Maze Yehoramu ajayo ari kumwe n’intwazangabo ziwe, n’imikogote yiwe yose. Abanyedomu baramukikuza hamwe n’iyo mikogote n’abayigendesha, ariko mw’ijoro arahaguruka, abacamwo aragenda.

Kuva ico gihe, Abanyedomu baca barikukira, bikura ku Buyuda gushika n’ubu. N’igisagara c’i Libuna na co nyene gica kiragarariza cikura ku Buyuda, kuko Yehoramu yari yataye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Yari yarubatse n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi y’i Buyuda, kandi atuma abantu b’i Yerusalemu bihumanya, azimiza Abayuda.
Yehoramu aronka ikete rivuye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Eliya, ryavuga riti: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya so Dawidi, avuze: ‘Ntiwagendeye mu nzira za so Yehoshafati canke iza Asa umwami w’i Buyuda.

Ariko wagendeye mu nzira z’abami b’Abisirayeli, kandi wazimije Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ubajana mu nzira zo kwihumanisha ubusambanyi, nk’uko inzu ya Ahabu yabikoze. Kandi wishe abavukanyi bawe bwite, abo mu nzu ya so, abantu bakurusha kuba beza.
None rero nawe Uhoraho agira yice abantu bawe, abahungu bawe, abagore bawe, aherengeteze n’ibintu vyawe vyose.
Wewe ubwawe uzogwara ingwara idakira yo mu mara, igende ikura gushika aho amara yawe azosohoka hanze.’ ”
Uhoraho ateza ubwansi hagati ya Yehoramu n’Abafilisitiya n’Abarabu babana n’Abanyetiyopiya.
Batera i Buyuda barahafata, banyaga ivyiza vyose basanze mu ngoro y’umwami, hamwe n’abahungu biwe n’abagore biwe. Nta muhungu n’umwe bamusigarije atari Ahaziya yari muto muri bo.
Inyuma y’ivyo vyose, Uhoraho ateza Yehoramu ingwara idakira y’amara.

Iyo ngwara igenda ikura, mu mpera y’umwaka ugira kabiri, amara yiwe arasohoka kubera iyo ngwara, maze apfa ari mu bubabare bwinshi. Abantu biwe ntibamucanira umuriro ngo baturire ibimota neza vyo kumuhesha icubahiro nk’uko babikoreye ba sekuruza.

Yehoramu yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n’ibiri igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, maze aganza imyaka umunani ari i Yerusalemu. Apfuye nta n’umwe yababajwe n’urupfu rwiwe. Nuko ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ariko ntiyashirwa mu mva z’abami.

Ab’i Yerusalemu bimika Ahaziya umuhererezi wa Yehoramu, aba umwami mu gishingo ca se, kuko bakuru biwe bose bari bishwe bahitanywe na ca gitero c’ingabo zazananye n’Abarabu zibatsinda aho bashagaje. Nuko Ahaziya mwene Yehoramu umwami w’i Buyuda atangura kuganza.
Ahaziya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza umwaka umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Ataliya, umwuzukuru wa Omuri.
Na we nyene agendera mu ngeso z’ab’inzu ya Ahabu, kuko nyina yamwosha gukora ibibi.
Akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , nk’uko ab’inzu ya Ahabu bakora, kuko se amaze gupfa ari bo babaye abahanuzi biwe, maze bimukwegera kuranduka.
Yongera akurikiza inama bamugiriye igihe yajana na Yoramu mwene Ahabu umwami w’Abisirayeli kugwanya Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya i Ramoti Gileyadi. Abasiriya bakomeretsa Yoramu;

aca asubira i Yezireyeli kugira ngo akirireyo inguma yakomerekeye i Ramoti mu ntambara agwana na Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya. Nuko Ahaziya mwene Yehoramu umwami w’i Buyuda aramanuka aja i Yezireyeli gusuhuza Yoramu mwene Ahabu kuko yari yarakomeretse.

Muri uko kuja kumusuhuza, Imana yari yateguye gukuraho Ahaziya. Ahaziya ashitse, asohokana na Yoramu ngo baje gusanganira Yehu mwene Nimushi, uwo Uhoraho yari yimikishije amavuta ngo aze akureho ab’inzu ya Ahabu.
Igihe Yehu yariko araherengeteza ab’inzu ya Ahabu, ahura n’abaganwa b’i Buyuda n’abahungu b’incuti za Ahaziya bakorera Ahaziya, maze arabica.

Nuko yinjira mu nzu kurondera Ahaziya, abantu ba Yehu bamufatira aho yari yinyegeje i Samariya. Bamuzanira Yehu aca aramwica. Baca baramuhamba, kuko bavuga bati: “Yari mwene Yehoshafati, yarondera Uhoraho n’umutima wiwe wose.” Nuko ntihasigara umuntu n’umwe mu bo mu nzu kwa Ahaziya afise ububasha bukwiye bwo kuba umwami.
Ataliya nyina wa Ahaziya abonye ko umuhungu wiwe apfuye, atangura kwica abana b’umwami bose bo mu muryango wa Yuda.

Ariko Yehosheba, umukobwa w’umwami Yehoramu, afata Yowashi mwene Ahaziya aramunyuruza amukuye mu bandi bana b’umwami bagira bicwe, amunyegeza mu cumba co kuryamamwo ari kumwe n’umurezi wiwe. Kubera ko Yehosheba, umukobwa w’umwami Yehoramu akaba n’umugore w’umuherezi Yehoyada yari mushiki wa Ahaziya, vyatumye ashobora kunyegeza uwo mwana kugira ngo Ataliya ntamwice.
Agumana na bo anyegejwe mu Ngoro y’Imana kumara imyaka itandatu Ataliya ari we atwara ico gihugu.

Mu mwaka ugira indwi Yehoyada arahaguruka, atumako intwazangabo zitwara abasoda ijanijana ari bo Azariya mwene Yerohamu, Ishimayeli mwene Yehohanani, Azariya mwene Obedi, Mayaseya mwene Adaya, na Elishafati mwene Zikuri, agiriranira isezerano na bo.
Bakwiragira hose mu Buyuda, bakoranya Abalewi n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli baraza bavuye mu bisagara vyose. Bashitse i Yerusalemu,
ikoraniro ryose rigiriranira isezerano n’umwami mu Ngoro y’Imana. Yehoyada arababwira ati: “Nguwu umwana w’umwami! Uwu ni we azoganza nk’uko Uhoraho yabisezeraniye uruvyaro rwa Dawidi.
Ibi ni vyo mukwiye gukora: igice kimwe ca gatatu ca mwebwe abaherezi n’Abalewi muzoba muramukiwe gukora kw’Isabato muze mucungere imiryango,
ikindi ca gatatu canyu kize kije ku ngoro y’umwami, ica gatatu ca nyuma kije kw’Irembo ry’Umushinge, maze abasigaye bose baze baje mu kibuga c’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Ntihaze hagire uwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho atari abaherezi n’Abalewi bazoba bari ku gikorwa cabo. Abo bo bazoshobora kwinjira kuko barobanuwe, ariko abandi bose baze bitondere ico Uhoraho yabashinze.
Abalewi bazohagarare bakikuje umwami, umuntu wese afise ibigwanisho mu maboko yiwe. Uwuzogerageza kwinjira mu Ngoro wese aze yicwe. Muzogume hafi y’umwami aho azoja hose.”

Abalewi n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda bakora nk’uko Yehoyada umuherezi yabibabwiye. Umwe wese ahitana abantu biwe, baba abari baramukiwe kuja gukora kw’Isabato n’abari bagombowe kuko Yehoyada umuherezi atemereye n’umwe muri iyo migwi gutaha.
Maze umuherezi Yehoyada aca aha intwazangabo z’ingabo ijanijana amacumu n’inkinzo nini na ntoya vyahora ari ivy’umwami Dawidi vyari bibitswe mu Ngoro y’Imana.
Ashira mu bibanza abantu bose, umwe wese afise ikigwanisho mu minwe, bakikuza umwami, hafi y’igicaniro n’Ingoro, kuva mu bumanuko gushika mu buraruko bw’Ingoro.

Yehoyada n’abahungu biwe basohokana umwana w’umwami bamwambika urugori; bamuzanira n’ikopi y’ivyagezwe vy’Imana batangaza ko abaye umwami. Bamusukako amavuta, baca barasemerera bati: “Umwami nahangame!”
Maze Ataliya yumvise urwamo rw’abantu bashimagiza umwami, aca aja iyo bari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Aravye, abona umwami ahagaze hafi y’inkingi mu rwinjiriro. Abatware n’abavuza inzamba bari i ruhande yiwe, abantu bose bo mu gihugu banezerewe bavuza inzamba, abaririmvyi na bo n’ibicurarangisho vyabo barongora abantu mu guhimbaza Imana. Nuko Ataliya yitaburirako impuzu arasemerera ati: “Uwo ni umugararizo! Uwo ni umugararizo!”

Umuherezi Yehoyada aca abwira intwazangabo zitwara abasoda ijanijana ati: “Nimumusohore hanze mumucishe hagati y’imirongo y’ingabo kandi mwicishe inkota uwomukurikira wese.” Kuko umuherezi yari yavuze ati: “Ntimumwicire mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .”
Nuko baramufata bamucisha mw’Irembo ry’Amafarasi rija ku mbuga y’ingoro y’umwami, bamwiciraho.
Yehoyada aca ashiraho isezerano ko we n’abantu n’umwami bazoba abantu b’ Uhoraho .
Abantu bose baca baja ku ngoro ya Bayali barayisenyagura. Basitagura ibicaniro n’ibigirwamana, bafata Matani umuherezi wa Bayali, bamwicira imbere y’ibicaniro.

Nuko Yehoyada ashiraho abantu barinda Ingoro y’ Uhoraho bavuye mu baherezi b’Abalewi, abo Dawidi yari yarajeje iyo Ngoro, ngo bashikanire Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose; maze bakabikora banezerewe, baririmba, nk’uko Dawidi yabitegetse.
Yongera ashiraho abo kurinda amarembo ku miryango y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho kugira ngo ntihagire uwahumanijwe n’ikintu na kimwe yokwinjira.

Ajana za ntwazangabo z’abasoda ijanijana, abubahwa, abatware n’abantu bose bo muri ico gihugu, amanukana umwami amukuye mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Baja ku kirimba baciye kw’Irembo ryo Haruguru, aca yicarika umwami ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami.
Abari aho bose bagira umunezero, n’igisagara kiba amahoro kuko Ataliya yari yicishijwe inkota.
Yowashi yari afise imyaka indwi igihe yaba umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo ine ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Zibiya w’i Berisheba.
Yowashi akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu myaka yose Yehoyada yamaze ari umuherezi.
Yehoyada amuhitiramwo abagore babiri, maze avyara abahungu n’abakobwa.
Haciye igihe Yowashi afata ingingo yo gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Akoranya abaherezi n’Abalewi arababwira ati: “Nimuje mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda mwegeranye amahera ategekanijwe kurihwa uko umwaka utashe mu Bisirayeli bose kugira ngo dusanure Ingoro y’Imana yacu. Mubikore ubu nyene.” Ariko Abalewi ntibaca babikora ubwo nyene.

Nuko umwami atumako Yehoyada umuherezi mukuru amubwira ati: “Ni kuki utabwiye Abalewi ngo baje mu bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu kwegeranya amatagisi yose yategetswe na Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho ngo atangwe n’ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli ku bw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro?”
Kuko abahungu ba wa mugore mubi Ataliya batobaguye Ingoro y’Imana bagafata ibintu vyose vyari vyaragizwe inyegu y’ Uhoraho bakaja kubikoreshereza Bayali.
Nuko umwami ategeka ko bakora isandugu bakayishira hafi y’umuryango w’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Hanyuma baca bamenyesha Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose ko bazanira Uhoraho itagisi Mose umusavyi w’Imana yari yarategetse Abisirayeli mu bugaragwa.
Abakuru bose n’abantu bose bazana amashikanwa yabo babikunze, bakayakororera muri iyo sandugu gushika aho yuzura.

Igihe cose iyo sandugu yaba yuzuye, Abalewi baca bayishira abanyabigega b’umwami. Umunyamabanga w’umwami n’umukozi w’umuherezi mukuru baca baza bagacuranura iyo sandugu bakayisubiza mu kibanza cayo hafi y’umuryango w’Ingoro. Bakora batyo ubudasiba maze begeranya amahera menshi.

Umwami na Yehoyada bafata ayo mahera bayaha abantu bakurikirana ivyo gusanura iyo ngoro. Baciye bashiraho abubatsi b’impome n’abamanika ngo basanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , hamwe n’abahinga bacura ivyuma n’ibikozwe mu butare bw’umwakaka vyo kuyisanura.
