Abo bantu bashinzwe ico gikorwa batangura gukora, kandi ibikorwa vyo kuyisanura bigenda neza kuko babikurikirana. Basubiramwo Ingoro y’Imana bayigira nk’uko yari imeze ubwa mbere barayikomeza.

Bahejeje, bazanira umwami na Yehoyada amahera yasigaye, baca bayakoreshamwo ivyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho : ivyo bakoresha mu Ngoro no mu bimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, hamwe n’amasahani n’ibindi vy’inzahabu n’ifeza. Mu gihe cose Yehoyada yabayeho, ibimazi vyo guturirwa vyama bishikanirwa Uhoraho ubudasiba.
Ico gihe Yehoyada yari ashaje amaze imyaka myinshi, maze apfa yisaziye neza amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu.
Ahambwa hamwe n’abami mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ku bw’ivyiza yari yarakoze mu Bisirayeli, akongera akabikorera Imana n’Ingoro yayo.
Yehoyada amaze gupfa, abakuru b’i Buyuda baza kwunamira umwami, na we arabumviriza.
Baheba kuja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, ariko basenga inkingi za Ashera n’ibindi bigirwamana. Kubera ico caha cabo, uburake bw’Imana buza ku Bayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu.
Naho Uhoraho yatumye abavugishwa biwe kuri abo bantu ngo babagarukane kuri we, kandi naho babagirije ibibi bakora, ntibabumviye.

Nuko Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri Zakariya mwene Yehoyada umuherezi. Ahagarara imbere y’abantu avuga ati: “Ibi ni vyo Imana ivuze, ngo: ‘Ni kuki mwihaye kugarariza amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho ? Ntaco muzoshikako. Kubera ko mwahevye Uhoraho , na we arabahevye.’ ”
Ariko baja inama yo kumugirira nabi; maze umwami ategeka ko bamuterera amabuye ku mbuga y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho agapfa.
Umwami Yowashi ntiyibuka urukundo Yehoyada se wa Zakariya yari yaramweretse, ariko yica umuhungu wiwe. Igihe Zakariya yariko aracikana, avuga ati: “ Uhoraho aze arabe ivyo mukoze, azobibaharureko.”
Umwaka uheze, ingabo z’i Siriya ziza gutera Yowashi; zitera i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, bica abakuru baho bose. Barungikira umwami wabo i Damasiko ivyo basahuye vyose.

Naho ingabo z’Abasiriya zari zaje ari nke, Uhoraho agabura mu maboko yabo ingabo zibasumvya ubwinshi z’Abayuda. Kubera ko Abayuda bari barahevye Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, ni co catumye urubanza Imana yaciriye Yowashi rumushikako.

Abo Basiriya bagiye, basize Yowashi yakomeretse cane. Abakuru bakora i bwami bagira inama yo kumwica kuko yishe mwene Yehoyada umuherezi, baca bamutsinda mu buriri aho yari aryamye. Nuko arapfa, ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ariko ntibamuhamba mu mva z’abami.
Abamugiriye inama bari Zabadi, umuhungu w’umugore yitwa Shimeyati w’Umwamonikazi, hamwe na Yehozabadi, umuhungu w’umugore yitwa Shimurite w’Umunyamowabukazi.

Inkuru z’abahungu ba Yowashi, ivyavugishijwe vyinshi kuri we, n’ivyerekeye isanurwa ry’Ingoro y’Imana vyose vyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami. Maze Amaziya umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma, aba umwami mu gishingo ciwe.
Amaziya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’icenda ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yehoyadini, w’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, ariko ntiyabikorana umutima wiwe wose.
Amaze gukomeza ubwami bwiwe, aca afata abatware bishe umwami ari we se arabica.

Ariko ntiyica abana babo, kuko yubashe ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryanditswe mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vya Mose rivuga riti: “Ntihaze hagire umuvyeyi yicwa azira abana biwe, canke abana ngo bicwe bazira abavyeyi babo, umwe wese azozire ivyaha vyiwe.”

Amaziya atumako Abayuda bose ngo bakoranire hamwe, abashira mu migwi akurikije imiryango yabo, abaha abakuru b’ingabo igihumbi n’abatwara ijanijana, i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini hose. Maze agira rusansuma rw’abafise imyaka mirongo ibiri canke irenga asanga hari abagabo ibihumbi amajana atatu bashobora kuja ku rugamba, kandi bashobora no gukoresha icumu n’inkinzo.
Yongera arondera abandi bagwanyi b’abacangero ibihumbi ijana bavuye mu Bisirayeli, abahemba italanto ijana z’ifeza.

Ariko umuntu w’Imana aza aho ari, aramubwira amubwira ati: “Yewe mwami, izi ngabo zivuye mu Bisirayeli ntuzijane ku rugamba, kuko Uhoraho atari kumwe n’Abisirayeli canke n’umuntu n’umwe wo mu Befurayimu.
Kandi niwapfa kujana na bo, naho wogenda ukagwana n’ubuhizi bwinshi ku rugamba, Uhoraho azotuma utsindwa imbere y’umwansi, kuko Imana ifise ububasha bwo gutuma utsinda canke utsindwa.”
Amaziya abaza uwo muntu w’Imana ati: “None ivya za talanto ijana nahemvye ba bagwanyi b’Abisirayeli bizogenda gute?” Uwo muntu w’Imana amwishura ati: “ Uhoraho ashobora kuguha ibirengeye ivyo cane.”
Nuko Amaziya aca afata izo ngabo zari zaje zivuye mu Befurayimu azirungika iwabo. Bituma bashavurira Abayuda, baca basubira iwabo bashangashiwe cane.
Maze Amaziya arinanata, aca atwara ingabo ziwe mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu, aho yiciye abantu b’i Seyiri ibihumbi cumi.
Ingabo z’i Buyuda zongera gufata mpiri abandi ibihumbi cumi, babadugana hejuru ku kimanga c’igitandara, maze babatembagariza mu mwonga, bose baravunagurika, barapfa.

Muri ico gihe, za ngabo Amaziya yasubiza inyuma ntazemerere kujana na we mu ntambara, zitera ibisagara vy’i Buyuda kuva i Samariya gushika i Beti-Horoni. Zica abantu ibihumbi bitatu, zihasahura n’ibintu vyinshi cane.
Amaziya agarutse avuye kwica ba Banyedomu, azana ibigirwamana vy’abantu b’i Seyiri, aca abishinga nk’imana ziwe bwite, aravyunamira, abishikanira ibimazi bituriwe.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringira Amaziya, aca amutumako umuvugishwa, amubaza ati: “Ni kuki usiguza izo mana z’abo bantu, zitashoboye gukiza benezo ukuboko kwawe?”

Akiriko aravuga, umwami amubwira ati: “Hari uwakugize umuhanuzi w’umwami? Hora! Ni kuki wikwegera urupfu?” Maze uwo muvugishwa ntiyasubira kuvuga, ariko yongerako ati: “Ndazi ko Uhoraho yafashe ingingo yo kukwica, kuko wakoze ivyo ntiwumvire impanuro zanje.”
Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda amaze gusiguza abahanuzi biwe, atuma kuri Yowashi mwene Yehowahazi, Yehowahazi mwene Yehu umwami wa Isirayeli, amubwira ati: “Ingo duhure, tugwane imbonankubone!”

Ariko Yowashi umwami wa Isirayeli yishura Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda ati: “Muri Libani habaye igitovu, kibwira isederi ry’i Libani kiti: ‘Mpa umukobwa wawe abe umugore w’umuhungu wanje.’ Ariko haca haza igikoko kinini gihonyanga ca gitovu.
Wibwira ngo waranesheje Edomu none wuzuye ubwibone. Nezererwa intsinzi yawe hanyuma ugume iwawe. Ni kubera iki wikwegera amakuba, ukayakwegera n’Ubuyuda bwose?”
Ariko Amaziya ntiyamwumvira, kuko Imana yashaka kubatanga mu maboko ya Yehowashi, kuko barondeye imana zo muri Edomu.
Nuko Yowashi umwami w’Abisirayeli aratera. We na Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda bahanganira i Beti-Shemeshi mu Buyuda.
Abayuda baneshwa n’Abisirayeli, umusoda wese ahunga ataha i muhira iwe.

Yehowashi umwami wa Isirayeli acakira Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda mwene Yowashi, Yowashi mwene Ahaziya, amufatira ahitwa Beti-Shemeshi. Maze Yehowashi aca amutwara i Yerusalemu, asenyurira hasi uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu, uhereye kw’Irembo rya Efurayimu ugashitsa kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, ahantu hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana ane.

Asahura inzahabu n’ifeza n’ibindi bikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho vyarabwa na Obedi-Edomu, hamwe n’ubutunzi bwose bwari mu ngoro y’umwami. Afata n’abantu abagira inyagano, hanyuma asubira i Samariya.
Amaziya mwene Yowashi umwami w’i Buyuda yamaze imyaka cumi n’itanu inyuma y’urupfu rwa Yehowashi mwene Yehowahazi umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Amaziya, uhereye ku ntango ukageza ku mpera, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami b’i Buyuda na Isirayeli?

Kuva igihe Amaziya yatera ibitugu Uhoraho , ntabe akimwumvira, i Yerusalemu haciye haba inama y’abantu bagomba kumwica, na we aca arahunga aja i Lakishi, ariko barungika abantu bamusanga i Lakishi bamutsindayo.
Bamugarukana kw’ifarasi, bamuhamba hamwe na ba sekuruza mu Gisagara ca Yuda.
Nuko Abayuda bose bafata Uziya, yari afise imyaka icumi n’itandatu, bamwimika ngo abe umwami mu gishingo ca se Amaziya.
Ni we yasanuye Elati ahagarukana i Buyuda, umwami Amaziya amaze guhamvya ba sekuruza.
Uziya yari afise imyaka icumi n’itandatu igihe yaba umwami, hanyuma aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n’ibiri ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yekoliya, w’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se Amaziya yakora.
Arondera Imana mu gihe ca Zakariya, kuko ari we yamwigishije kwubaha Imana. Mu gihe cose yarondeye Uhoraho , na we yamuhaye kuroranirwa.
Aja kugwanya Abafilisitiya, asenyurira hasi inzitiro z’i Gati, i Yabune n’i Ashidodi. Maze aca yubaka ibisagara vyari hafi y’i Ashidodi n’ahandi hose mu Bafilisitiya.
Imana imufasha kugwanya Abafilisitiya n’Abarabu baba muri Guri-Bayali, n’Abameyunimu.
Abamoni bazanira Uziya amashikanwa yo kumwisaba, maze aba rurangiranwa gushika ku rubibe rwa Egiputa, kuko yabaye umunyenkomezi bihebuje.
Uziya yubaka iminara i Yerusalemu kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, yubaka iyindi kw’Irembo ryo mu Kiyaya no mu mfuruka z’uruzitiro, arayikomeza.

Yubaka kandi iminara mu bugaragwa, yimba n’ibinogo vyo kubika amazi vyinshi, kuko yari afise imikuku myinshi mu tubande no mu kiyaya. Yari afise abantu bamukorera mu mirima no mu nzabibu ziwe mu misozi no mu matongo amera cane y’i Karumeli, kuko yakunda uburimyi cane.

Uziya yari afise ingabo zigishijwe neza kugwana, zama ziteguye kuja ku rugamba ziri mu mice nk’uko ibitigiri vyabo vyari vyaharuwe mw’iharura ryagizwe na Yeyiyeli umunyamabanga, na Mayaseya umukuru w’ingabo, barongowe na Hananiya, umwe mu bakuru bakorera i bwami.
Igitigiri c’abakuru batwara amazu bari barongoye ingabo cari ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atandatu.
Bari barongoye ingabo zingana ibihumbi amajana atatu n’indwi n’amajana atanu bigishijwe ivy’intambara, kandi bakomeye bo gufasha umwami kugwanya abansi biwe.
Uziya ategura inkinzo, amacumu, inkofero, amakoti yo gukingira igikiriza, imiheto n’amabuye atereshwa umugozi bikwiye ingabo zose.

I Yerusalemu akora imashini zahinguwe n’abahinga zo gukoreshwa n’abagwanira ku minara no mu mfuruka zo kurasamwo imyampi, hamwe no gutera ibibuye bininibinini. Aramenyekana cane hose kuko Uhoraho yamufashije, gushika aho yabaye agakomeye.
Ariko amaze kuba agakomeye, ubwibone bwiwe bumuzanira kuranduka. Ata ubwizigirwa k’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe, maze yinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ngo aturire ibimota neza ku gicaniro.
Azariya umuherezi n’abandi baherezi b’ Uhoraho mirongo umunani barinda cane baramukurikira.

Baramwubahuka, bamubwira bati: “Ewe mwami Uziya, si vyiza ko wewe uturirira Uhoraho ibimota neza. Ivyo ni ivy’abaherezi, abo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, barobanuwe ngo baturirire ibimota neza Uhoraho . Sohoka uve ahera kuko wataye ubwizigirwa, kandi Uhoraho Imana ntazobigushimira.”

Uziya, yari afise icotezo mu ntoke yiteguye guturira ibimota neza, aca arashavura. Agishavuriye abo baherezi imbere yabo n’imbere y’igicaniro c’ivyo bimota neza, mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , imibembe imufatira aho nyene, iboneka mu ruhanga rwiwe.
Azariya umuherezi mukuru n’abandi baherezi bose bamuravye, babona atonzweko n’imibembe mu ruhanga, baca bihuta kumusohora hanze. Kandi na we nyene yihuta gusohoka, kuko Uhoraho yari amukubise.

Umwami Uziya agumana imibembe gushika ku musi yapfiriyeko. Aba mu kazu ka wenyene; kuko yari umunyamibembe, kandi ntiyemererwa kuja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Yotamu umuhungu wiwe aca aba ari we azezwa ikirimba, yongera atwara abantu bo muri ico gihugu.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Uziya, uhereye ku ntango ugashitsa ku mpera, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amozi.
Nuko Uziya arapfa, ahamvya ba sekuruza; ahambwa hafi yabo, mu rindi tongo ryari iry’abami, kuko abantu bavuga bati: “Yari umunyamibembe.” Maze Yotamu umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yotamu yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka icumi n’itandatu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yerusha, umukobwa wa Zadoki.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza, nk’uko se Uziya yakora, mugabo wewe ntiyacumura ngo yinjire mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Ariko abantu bo, baguma mu ngeso zabo mbi.
Yotamu ni we yasanuye Irembo ryo Haruguru ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , yubaka n’urundi ruzitiro rwo ku musozi Ofeli.
Yubaka kandi ibisagara mu misozi y’i Buyuda, n’iminara, n’ubwihisho bukomeye mu misozi iteyeko ibiti.

Yotamu agwana n’umwami w’Abamoni aramunesha. Uwo mwaka Abamoni bamushikanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba angana n’italanto ijana z’ifeza, ingero koru ibihumbi icumi z’ingano, n’ingero koru ibihumbi icumi za sayiri. Mu mwaka ugira kabiri n’uwugira gatatu bamuzanira nk’ivyo nyene.
Yotamu aba agakomeye kuko yagendera mu bitunganye imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yotamu, harimwo n’intambara zose yagwanye n’ibindi yakoze, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka icumi n’itandatu ari i Yerusalemu.
Yotamu arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Ahazi aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Ahazi yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’itandatu ari i Yerusalemu. Ariko ntiyakora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakora.
Ahubwo yagendeye mu ngeso z’abami ba Isirayeli mbere akora ibigirwamana vya Bayali.

Aturirira ibimazi mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, yongera atanga abana biwe nk’ikimazi ngo baturirwe. Uko ni ko yakoze ibizira vy’ubuyobe vyakorwa n’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye muri ico gihugu imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Yatanga ibimazi akongera agaturira n’ibimota neza, ivyo akabikorera hejuru mu mataba y’imisozi miremire no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye.

Ni co catumye Uhoraho Imana yiwe amutanga mu maboko y’umwami w’i Siriya. Abasiriya baramunesha, bafata mpiri abantu biwe benshi babagira imbohe, babajana i Damasiko. Yongera amutanga mu maboko y’umwami w’Abisirayeli, aramunesha bikomeye kandi ahatakariza ibintu vyinshi.
Kandi Peka mwene Remaliya, yica mu Bayuda ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri ku musi umwe; kuko Abayuda bari bahevye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Zikuri, umugwanyi w’Umwefurayimu, yica Mayaseya umuhungu w’umwami, yica Azurikamu umukuru w’ingabo ajejwe ikirimba, na Elukana yari icegera c’umwami.
Abagabo b’Abisirayeli bafata mpiri abavukanyi babo bakomotse i Buyuda, babatwara abagore ibihumbi amajana abiri, hamwe n’abahungu n’abakobwa. Babasahura n’ibintu vyinshi, babijana i Samariya.

Ariko uwavugishwa n’ Uhoraho yitwa Odedi yari ngaho i Samariya, aca aja guhura n’ingabo zariko ziratahuka. Arababwira ati: “Kubera Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza banyu yashavuriye Ubuyuda, yabagabuye mu maboko yanyu. Ariko rero mwarengeje urugero, mubarandurana uburake bwinshi, ku buryo vyashitse no mw’ijuru.
None ubu na ho mushaka ko abagabo n’abagore mwakuye i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu bahinduka abagurano banyu. Mbega none mweho ntimufise ivyaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu abagiriza?
None rero, nimunyumvirize! Nimurungike bagenzi banyu, bamwe mwafata nk’imbohe basubire inyuma, kuko uburake bw’ Uhoraho buri kuri mwebwe.”
Nuko bamwe mu batware bo mu Befurayimu, Azariya mwene Yehohanani, Berekiya mwene Meshilemoti, Yehizikiya mwene Shalumu, na Amasa mwene Hadulayi; bahangana n’abari bavuye ku rugamba.

Baravuga bati: “Ntimuzane izo mbohe hano, kuko twoba ducumuye imbere y’ Uhoraho . Mugomba mwongereze ivyaha vyacu? Musanzwe muzi ko icaha cacu ari kinini, kandi uburake bw’inkazi bwiwe bukaba buri ku Bisirayeli.”
Nuko izo ngabo zica zisiga abo bantu b’imbohe hamwe n’ivyasahuwe imbere y’abo bakuru n’ikoraniro ryose.

Abantu batowe kandi bagatororokanywa umwe wese ahamagawe izina bafata izo mbohe, maze bakura impuzu mu vyasahuwe, bambika abari gusa bo muri bo. Babaha impuzu n’ibirato, n’ivyokurya n’ivyo kunywa; babaha kandi n’imiti yo kuvura abakomeretse. Bashira ku ndogoba abarushe cane muri bo, maze babasubiza mu b’iwabo i Yeriko, igisagara c’ibigazi, baca basubira i Samariya.
Muri ico gihe umwami Ahazi atumako umwami w’i Ashuri ngo amutabare, kuko
Abanyedomu bari bongeye kugaruka gutera i Buyuda, bagatwara n’imbohe.
Abafilisitiya na bo bari bateye ibisagara vyo mu biyaya n’i Negebu h’i Buyuda; bafata Beti-Shemeshi, Ayaloni n’i Gederoti, hamwe n’i Soko, Timuna n’i Gimuzo, n’ibigwati bihakikije, baravyigarurira.
Uhoraho yari yacishije bugufi cane Abayuda kubera Ahazi umwami wa Isirayeli yari yatumye Abayuda bakora ibibi; mbere akarushiriza kuba mubi imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Tigulati-Pilineseri umwami w’i Ashuri aramwitaba araza, ariko aho kumufasha, amufata nk’umwansi aza kumugwanya.
Ico gihe Ahazi yari yafashe bimwe mu bintu vyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ivyo mu ngoro y’i bwami no mu mazu y’abaganwa, abiha umwami w’i Ashuri; ariko ivyo nta co vyamumariye.
No mu gihe c’ivyago umwami Ahazi yaburaniwe, arushiriza kugarariza Uhoraho .

Ashikanira ibimazi ibigirwamana vy’i Damasiko, kuko abantu baho bamunesheje; akiyumvira ati: “Ko imana z’abami b’i Siriya zabafashije, ndazishikaniye ibimazi nanje zontabara.” Ariko zamubereye umutego we hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose.
Ahazi yegeranya ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’Imana arabimenagura. Araheza yugara inzugi z’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho aca yubaka ibicaniro ku mayirabiri yose y’i Yerusalemu.
Mu gisagara cose c’i Buyuda, ashinga ku misozi miremire ibibanza vyo gutuririramwo ibimota neza, no gushikaniramwo ibimazi izindi mana, ivyo vyongera kuvyura uburake bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Ahazi n’ivyerekeye inzira ziwe, uhereye ku ntango ugashika ku mpera, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami b’i Buyuda n’Abisirayeli.
Ahazi arapfa, ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa i Yerusalemu, ariko ntiyashirwa mu mva z’abami ba Isirayeli. Maze umuhungu wiwe Hezekiya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Hezekiya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’icenda ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Abiya, umukobwa wa Zakariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakora.
Mu kwezi kwa mbere kw’umwaka wa mbere w’ingoma yiwe, yugurura inzugi z’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho arazisanura.
Atumako abaherezi n’Abalewi, abakoraniriza ku kibuga ahahera mu buseruko,
avuga ati: “Nimunyumve yemwe Balewi! Nimwihumanure ubu nyene mwongere muhumanure n’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza. Mukure Ahera ibihumanya vyose.
Ba data ntibabaye abizigirwa; bakoze ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, baramuheba. Batera ibitugu inzu y’ Uhoraho , na we nyene bamutera ibitugu.
Barongera bugara inzugi z’ibaraza, bazimya n’amatara. Vyongeye ntibashikaniye Imana y’Abisirayeli ibimota neza canke ikimazi na kimwe co guturirirwa Ahera hayo.
Ni co gituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwasutswe ku Bayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu; akabahindura ibimaramare, bakaba akabarore n’agatwengo, nk’uko mushobora kuvyibonera n’amaso yanyu.
Iki ni co catumye ba sogokuruza bacu bicwa n’inkota, abahungu bacu n’abakobwa bacu, eka mbere n’abagore bacu bakajanwa nk’imbohe.
None rero ubu nagabiye kugiriranira isezerano n’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo uburake bwiwe butuveko.
Nuko rero bagenzi, ibi ntimubifate minenerwe, kuko Uhoraho yabatoranije ngo muhagarare imbere yiwe mumukorera, ngo mukore igikorwa ciwe, mumuturirire ibimota neza.”

Nuko aba Balewi baca bitegurira gukora. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Kohati ni: Mahati mwene Amasayi na Yoweli mwene Azariya. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Merari ni: Kishi mwene Abudi na Azariya mwene Yehaleleli. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Gerishoni ni: Yowa mwene Zima na Edeni mwene Yowa.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Elizafani ni: Shimuri na Yeyiyeli. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Asafu ni: Zakariya na Mataniya.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Hemani ni: Yehiyeli na Shimeyi. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Yedutuni ni: Shemaya na Uziyeli.
Bamaze gukoranya benewabo b’Abalewi no kwihumanura, baca barinjira kugira ngo bahumanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko umwami yari yabibategetse, yisunze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .

Abaherezi binjira imbere mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kugira ngo bayihumanure. Maze basohora hanze mu rugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ikintu cose gihumanye basanze muri iyo Ngoro. Abalewi na bo baca baravyakira babimanukana mu mwonga wa Kidironi.

Batanguye guhumanura Ingoro ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, maze ku musi w’umunani w’ukwo kwezi bashika ku rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho . Mu misi umunani yakurikiye, bahumanura Ingoro ubwayo; barangiza ico gikorwa ku musi wa cumi na gatandatu w’ukwezi kwa mbere.

Baca binjira aho umwami Hezekiya yari ari bamubwira bati: “Twahumanuye ingoro yose y’ Uhoraho , igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi n’ibikoresho vyaco, n’imeza y’imikate ishikaniwe Imana n’ibikoresho vyayo vyose.
Twateguye turongera turahumanura ibikoresho vyose umwami Ahazi yari yarasohoye kubera kutubaha Imana kwiwe igihe yari umwami. Ubu biri imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho .”
Bukeye mu gatondo ka kare umwami Hezekiya akoranya abakuru bo mu gisagara baca baduga ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Bazana amashuri y’inka indwi, impfizi z’intama indwi, imyagazi y’intama indwi, n’amasuguru y’impene indwi, babitanga kw’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha ku bw’ubwami, ku bw’Ingoro no ku bw’Abayuda. Umwami ategeka abaherezi, abo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, ngo babitangire ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho .

Nuko bakerera ya mashuri, maze abaherezi batwara amaraso bayamija ku gicaniro; hanyuma bakerera za mpfizi z’intama, amaraso yazo bayamija ku gicaniro; baca bakerera na ya myagazi y’intama, amaraso yayo bayamija ku gicaniro.
Za suguru z’impene zo gutangwako ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha zizanwa imbere y’umwami n’ikoraniro ryose, bazirambikako ibiganza.

Abaherezi baca barazikerera, amaraso yazo bayazana ku gicaniro co gutangirako ikimazi c’ivyaha kugira ngo batangire impongano Abisirayeli bose, kuko umwami yari yategetse ko baturira ikimazi c’ivyaha bagatanga n’ishikanwa ry’ivyaha kubw’Abisirayeli bose.

Ahagarika Abalewi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bafise ibicurarangisho bisamirana, inanga n’amakembe, nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi na Gadi uwerekwa w’umwami hamwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Natani. Ivyo vyari vyategetswe n’ Uhoraho abicishije mu bo yavugisha.
Nuko Abalewi bahagarara bafise ivyo bicurarangisho vya Dawidi, abaherezi na bo bafise inzamba zabo.

Nuko Hezekiya ategeka ko batangira vya bimazi biturirwa ku gicaniro. Bagitangura kubitanga, indirimbo zo guhimbaza Uhoraho zica zirasamirana, inzamba ziravuzwa, na vya bicurarangisho vya Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Ikoraniro ryose rirunama rirasenga, mu gihe abaririmvyi bariko bararirimba bavuza n’inzamba. Ivyo birabandanya gushika bahejeje gutanga vya bimazi vyo guturirwa.
Bahejeje gutanga ivyo bimazi, umwami n’abari ngaho bose barapfukama barasenga.

Umwami Hezekiya n’abakuru bari kumwe na we bategeka Abalewi guhimbaza Uhoraho bakoresheje amajambo ya Dawidi n’aya Asafu uwerekwa. Nuko baririmba indirimbo zo gutazira banezerewe, baca bunamika imitwe yabo barasenga.

Maze Hezekiya aravuga ati: “Ubu rero mwamaze kwiyegurira Uhoraho . Nimuzane ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .” Nuko ikoraniro ryose rizana ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe, n’abandi bose bavyishakiye bazana n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Igitigiri c’amashikanwa ikoraniro ryazanye cari amashuri y’inka mirongo indwi, impfizi z’intama ijana, n’imyagazi y’intama amajana abiri; vyose hamwe biba ibimazi vyo guturirwa bishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Ibitungwa vyose vyashikaniwe Uhoraho nk’ibimazi vyari amashuri y’inka amajana atandatu n’intama n’impene ibihumbi bitatu.

Ariko Abaherezi bari bake cane ntibashobora kubaga vya bimazi vyose. Nuko bagenzi babo b’Abalewi barabafasha gushika igikorwa giheze, mbere gushika n’abandi baherezi barobanuwe, kuko Abalewi bashize umutima ku gukora ibitunganye kurusha abaherezi.

Hariho ibimazi vyo guturirwa vyinshi cane, hamwe n’ibinure vy’ibimazi vy’ishimwe n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa aherekeza ivyo bimazi vyo guturirwa. Nuko igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kiba kirasubijweho.
Hezekiya n’abantu bose baranezerwa kubera ivyo Imana yari ishikije ku bantu bayo, kuko vyari bikozwe mu mwanya muto.

Hezekiya atumako Abisirayeli bose n’Abayuda, kandi yandikira amakete Abefurayimu n’Abamanase, abaha ubutumire ngo baze mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Umwami n’abaganwa biwe n’ikoraniro ryose bari i Yerusalemu bari biyemeje guhimbaza Pasika mu kwezi kwa kabiri.
Ntibari bwashobore kuyihimbaza mu bihe vyategekanijwe kuko ata baherezi bakwiye bari bwarobanurwe, kandi abantu ntibari bwigere bakoranira i Yerusalemu.
Iyo nteguro yo guhimbaza Pasika yabonetse ko ari nziza ku mwami no ku bantu bose.

Baca bafata ingingo yo gutuma intumwa mu Bwisirayeli hose, uhereye i Berisheba mu bumanuko ugashika i Dani mu buraruko, bahamagara abantu ngo baze i Yerusalemu guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli. Ntibari bwayihimbaze ari benshi nk’uko vyari vyaranditswe.

Kw’itegeko ry’umwami, intumwa zikwira hose mu Bwisirayeli n’i Buyuda zitwaye amakete avuye ku mwami no ku baganwa biwe, avuga ngo: “Yemwe Bisirayeli mwese, nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Aburahamu, na Isaka na Isirayeli, kugira ngo na we abagarukeko mwebwe abasigaye, mutahitanywe n’agatikizo k’abami b’i Ashuri.
Ntimube nka ba sogokuruza na benewanyu, babaye ibigaba imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, ari co catumye ibahindura akajoreza nk’uko mubibona.

Ntimukomantaze imitima nk’uko ba sogokuruza banyu bayikomantaje; mwumvire Uhoraho . Muze mu Ngoro yiwe, iyo yejeje akayitoranya ibihe bidashira. Mukorere Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugira ngo uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi bubaveko.

Nimwahindukirira Uhoraho , benewanyu n’abana banyu bazogirirwa akagongwe n’ababajanye nk’inyagano maze bagaruke muri iki gihugu, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari inyembabazi kandi igira ikigongwe cinshi. Nimwamuhindukirira, ntazobakurako inyonga ziwe.”
Za ntumwa ziragenda, ziva mu gisagara zija mu kindi, mu Befurayimu no mu Bamanase, gushika mu Bazebuloni; ariko abantu baritwengera, barabakengera.
Yamara abantu bamwe bo mu Basheri, Abamanase n’Abazebuloni bicisha bugufi baja i Yerusalemu.
No mu Buyuda, ukuboko kw’Imana kuba ku bantu baho, abaha kugira umutima umwe wo gukora ivyo umwami n’abaganwa biwe bari bategetse, bivuye mw’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Nuko mu kwezi kwa kabiri, abantu benshi bakoranira i Yerusalemu ngo bahimbaze Umusi Mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Bakuraho ibicaniro vyari i Yerusalemu, basambura n’ibicaniro batangirako ibimota neza, babita mu mwonga wa Kidironi.

Maze ku musi ugira cumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa kabiri, bakerera umwagazi wa Pasika. Abaherezi n’Abalewi bari buzuye ibimaramare, baca barihumanura maze bazana ibimazi vyo guturirwa mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Maze baca baja mu bibanza vyabo nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose umuntu w’Imana. Abaherezi bamija ku gicaniro amaraso baherejwe n’Abalewi.

Kubera ko mw’ikoraniro harimwo abantu benshi batari bihumanuye, Abalewi ni bo bahavuye bakerera imyagazi y’intama ya Pasika y’abantu bose bari bahumanye, kuko batashobora gushikiriza iyo myagazi yabo Uhoraho .

Kandi naho abantu benshi mu bari bavuye mu Befurayimu, mu Bamanase, mu Bisakari no mu Bazebuloni batari bihumanuye, barariye Pasika, banyuranya n’uko vyanditswe. Ariko, Hezekiya arabasengera, avuga ati: “Icompa Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza, akababarira umuntu wese
yashize umutima wiwe ku kurondera Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza naho ahumanye ku bw’amategeko y’Ahera.”
Maze Uhoraho yumva ugusenga kwa Hezekiya, akiza abantu.

Abisirayeli bari i Yerusalemu bahimbaza Umusi Mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, bamara imisi indwi banezerewe cane, mu gihe Abalewi n’abaherezi baguma bararirimbira Uhoraho ku musi ku musi, bakoresheje ibicurarangisho bisamirana, vyeguriwe Uhoraho .

Hezekiya avuga amajambo yo gutera intege Abalewi bose bari berekanye ko batahura neza igikorwa c’Imana. Muri iyo misi indwi bariye umugabane wabo batanga n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe barongera bahimbaza Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Maze ikoraniro ryose rica ryemeranya kwongerako iyindi misi indwi, bayimara bahimbaza Imana kandi banezerewe.

Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ategura amashuri y’inka igihumbi n’intama n’impene ibihumbi indwi ku bw’iryo koraniro, n’abaganwa na bo batanga amashuri y’inka igihumbi n’intama n’impene ibihumbi cumi. Igitigiri kinini c’abaherezi barihumanura.
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abayuda riranezerwa, hamwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abari bakoraniye hamwe na bo bavuye mu Bisirayeli, harimwo n’abanyamahanga bari baje bava mu Bwisirayeli n’ababa i Buyuda.
Hari umunezero mwinshi cane i Yerusalemu, kuko kuva mu misi ya Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli hatari bwabe ikintu nk’ico i Yerusalemu.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi barahaguruka ngo bahezagire abantu, maze Imana irabumva, kuko isengesho ryabo ryashitse mw’ijuru, ahera hayo, aho iba.

Ivyo vyose biheze, Abisirayeli bose bari ngaho barasohoka baja mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, basitagura inkingi z’amabuye zose, batemagura n’inkingi za Ashera. Basambura ibicaniro vyo ku mataba y’imisozi n’ibicaniro vyari i Buyuda hose, i Bubenyamini, mu Befurayimu no mu Bamanase. Abisirayeli bamaze gusambura vyose, baca basubira mu bisagara vyabo no mu ngo zabo.

Hezekiya ashira abaherezi n’Abalewi mu mice; umuce wose ukurikije ibikorwa vyabo, ngo batange ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe, bongere bakore ibikorwa vy’Imana, batange amashimwe kandi bahimbarize ku marembo y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umwami na we araterera, atanga ku bivuye mu butunzi bwiwe ngo bikoreshwe mu bimazi vyo guturirwa mu gitondo, ivyo ku mugoroba, ivyo ku masabato, ivy’ukwezi guserutse, n’ivyo ku misi mikuru yashinzwe nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .
Ategeka abantu baba i Yerusalemu ngo batange ivyo bakuye mu vyabo bigenewe abaherezi n’Abalewi kugira ngo abo na bo bashobore kwiyegurira ibikorwa vy’Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .

Iryo tegeko rigisohoka, Abisirayeli batangana umutima ubikunze ku vya mbere vyeze vyo mu vyimburwa vyabo vy’ibinyantete, umuvinyu mushasha, amavuta, ubuki n’ibindi vyose biva mu burimyi. Bazana ibintu vyinshi, n’ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyose.

Abantu bo mu Bwisirayeli n’i Buyuda baba mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, na bo bazana ikigiracumi co mu masho yabo n’imikuku yabo hamwe n’ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyeguriwe Uhoraho Imana yabo, barabirunda biba ikirundo kinini.
Batanguye kubikora mu kwezi kwa gatatu babiheza mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Maze Hezekiya n’abaganwa biwe baje bakabona ivyo birundo, bahimbaza Uhoraho kandi bahezagira abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Hezekiya abaza abaherezi n’Abalewi ivyerekeye ivyo birundo ati: “Mbega ibi bintu vyose vyavuye hehe?”

Maze Azariya umuherezi mukuru, yava mu muryango wa Sadoki, amwishura ati: “Kuva igihe abantu batanguriye kuzana intererano zabo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , dufise ivyokurya bikwiye hamwe n’ibirenzeko vyinshi twimbuye, kuko Uhoraho yahezagiye abantu biwe, kandi ibi vyinshi ubona ni ibirenzeko.”
Hezekiya ategeka ko bategura ububiko mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , na bo babigenza gutyo.

Maze bazana intererano zabo mu bwizigirwa, ivyo batanze ku bw’ico gikorwa, ibigiracumi n’ivyo batanze nk’ingabire zeguriwe Imana. Konaniya, Umulewi, ni we yari ajejwe kubiraba; uwo bavukana Shimeyi akaba icegera ciwe.

Yehiyeli, Azaziya, Nahati, Asaheli, Yerimoti, Yozabadi, Eliyeli, Isimakiya, Mahati na Benaya bari abunganizi bafasha Konaniya na Shimeyi mwenewabo. Bashizweho n’umwami Hezekiya na Azariya umukuru yari ashinzwe Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Kora mwene Imuna Umulewi, yari umurinzi w’Irembo ryo mu Buseruko; yari ajejwe n’amashikanwa yashikaniwe Imana, atanzwe nk’uko umuntu wese avyishakiye, no kugabura izo ntererano zihawe Uhoraho hamwe n’ingabire zatanzwe ngo zibe inyegu y’Imana.

Mu bisagara vy’abaherezi, yari afise abamufasha mu bwizigirwa ari bo Edeni, Miniyamini, Yesuwa, Shemaya, Amariya na Shekaniya; bakagaburira bagenzi babo b’abaherezi nk’uko imice yabo yari iri, baba abakuze canke abakiri bato.

Hamwe n’ivyo, bagaburira n’abahungu bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka itatu n’iyirenga, abo amazina yabo yari yanditswe mu ntonde z’ingene abantu bagiye bararondoka, abashobora kwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bose ngo bakore ibikorwa bajejwe kandi bitandukanye vyo ku musi ku musi, hakurikijwe kandi imigwi yabo n’ivyo yashinzwe.

Bagaburira abaherezi bahawe ibikorwa hakurikijwe imiryango yabo nk’uko vyari mu ntonde z’ingene bagiye bararondoka, kandi n’Abalewi bikagenda gutyo, abamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga, nk’uko ibikorwa vyabo n’imice yabo vyari biri.
Bongeramwo n’abakiri bato, abagore, abahungu n’abakobwa bo muri uwo muryango bose banditswe ku ntonde z’ingene bagiye bararondoka; kuko bari babaye abizigirwa mu kwiyegurira Imana rwose.

Ku vy’abaherezi, abakomoka kuri Aroni baba mu matongo akikije ibisagara vyabo canke mu bindi bisagara ivyo ari vyo vyose, hariho abagabo bari batoranijwe, bagenwa ku mazina yabo ngo bagaburire imigabane umugabo wese yari muri bo n’abandi bose bari ku rutonde rw’Abalewi.
Ivyo ni vyo Hezekiya yakoze mu Buyuda hose; akora ibigororotse, bitunganye kandi vyo kwizigirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Ivyo yakoze vyose, vyaba ibijanye n’igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana canke ivyo kwumvira Ivyagezwe vyayo n’amabwirizwa yayo, yarondeye Imana yiwe n’umutima wiwe wose. Ivyo vyatumye aroranirwa muri vyose.
Inyuma y’ivyo vyose Hezekiya yakoze mu bwizigirwa, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri aza gutera i Buyuda. Yugariza ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye, agomba kuvyigarurira.
Maze Hezekiya abonye ko Senakeribu yaje kandi ko atumbereye kugwanya Yerusalemu,
avugana n’abaganwa biwe n’abakuru b’ingabo ngo bazibire amazi yo mu masoko yose yari inyuma y’igisagara, maze baramufasha.
Abantu benshi barakorana, bazibira amasoko yose n’umugezi wose watemba mu gihugu. Baravuga bati: “Ni iki cotuma umwami w’i Ashuri aza agasanga amazi yuzuye?”

Aca akora cane mu gusanura ibihengeri vyose vy’uruzitiro no mu kwubaka iminara kuri rwo. Yubaka n’urundi ruzitiro inyuma y’urwo, akomeza n’amabaraza yo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Yongera acurisha ibigwanisho vyinshi n’inkinzo nyinshi.
Ashinga abakuru b’ingabo bo kurongora abantu, aca arabakoranya imbere yiwe i ruhande y’irembo ry’igisagara, maze abatera intege muri aya majambo ati:
“Mukomere kandi mureme. Ntimutinye canke ngo mwihebure kubera umwami w’i Ashuri n’ingabo nyinshi ziri kumwe na we; kuko hari ubushobozi bwinshi buri kumwe natwe kuruta uburi kumwe na we.
We yishimikije inkomezi z’umuntu w’inyama n’amaraso, ariko tweho turi kumwe n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ngo itugwanire intambara.” Maze abantu bararema kubw’amajambo Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda avuze.

Hanyuma y’ivyo, igihe Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri n’ingabo ziwe zose bari bugarije i Lakishi, yaciye arungika abaganwa biwe i Yerusalemu, abarungikana ubutumwa kwa Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda bari aho, ati:
“Uku ni ko Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri avuze: ngo mbega mwishimirije iki cotuma muguma i Yerusalemu kandi hugarijwe?
Iyo Hezekiya ababwiye ngo: ‘ Uhoraho Imana yacu iradukiza idukure mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Ashuri,’ aba ariko arabahenda, kugira ngo mwicwe n’inzara n’inyota.

Mbega Hezekiya ubwiwe si we yakuyeho ibicaniro vyo ku misozi n’ibindi bicaniro vyose vy’imana, akabwira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ati: ‘Muzohora musengera imbere y’igicaniro kimwe kandi ni co muzoturirirako ibimazi’?
Mbega ntimuzi ivyo twe na ba sogokuruza banje twakoreye abantu bose bo mu yandi mahanga? Mbega imana z’ayo mahanga hari aho zigeze zishobora kuyakiza ngo zikure igihugu cayo mu kuboko kwanje?
Mbega mu mana zose z’ayo mahanga ba data basanganguye, ni izihe zashoboye gukiza abantu bazo ukuboko kwanje? None imana yanyu yobakiza gute mu maboko yanje?

Nuko ntimwemere ko Hezekiya abahenda canke ngo abazimize kugeza hiyo. Ntimwemere ivyo ababwira, kuko ata mana y’ihanga na rimwe canke y’ubwami na bumwe yashoboye gukiza abantu bayo ngo ibakure mu kuboko kwanje canke kwa ba sogokuruza bacu. Mbega ibi ntibirushirije kubereka ko imana yanyu itazoshobora kubakura mu kuboko kwanje?”
Maze izo ntumwa za Senakeribu zivuga n’ibindi vyinshi vyo gucokora Uhoraho Imana n’umusavyi wayo Hezekiya.

Uwo mwami yandika n’ayandi amakete yo gutuka Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli; mu kuyicokora yongera avuga ngo: “Nk’uko imana z’ayandi mahanga zitashoboye gutabara abantu bazo ngo zibakure mu kuboko kwanje, ni ko n’imana ya Hezekiya itazokiza iri hanga mu kuboko kwanje.”
Nuko bahamagara abantu b’i Yerusalemu bari ku ruzitiro, bababwira mu Giheburayo kugira ngo babace ivutu, maze babone gufata igisagara.
Bavuga Imana y’i Yerusalemu bayigereranya n’imana z’ayandi mahanga yo mw’isi, zakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Umwami Hezekiya n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amozi barasemerera, basenga barangamije mw’ijuru ku bw’ivyo.

Nuko Uhoraho arungika umumarayika, yica ingabo z’abahizi bose, harimwo n’intwazangabo nkurunkuru, abasanze aho umwami w’Abashuri yari acumbitse. Maze wa mwami w’Abashuri aca asubira inyuma mu gihugu ciwe ateterewe. Umusi umwe agiye mu ngoro y’imana yiwe, bamwe mu bahungu biwe bamucumita inkota arapfa.
Uko ni ko Uhoraho yatabaye Hezekiya n’abantu b’i Yerusalemu, abakiza ukuboko kwa Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri n’ukuboko kw’abandi bansi; abarinda impande zose.
Benshi bazanira Uhoraho ibimazi i Yerusalemu n’amashikanwa y’agaciro, bayazanira Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Kuva ico gihe amahanga yose aca aramutinya.
Muri iyo misi Hezekiya aragwara ashika ku mpfiro. Asenga Uhoraho , na we aramwishura, amuha ikimenyetso c’igitangaza.
Ariko umutima wa Hezekiya wari wuzuye ubwibone bituma atamenya ubuntu yagiriwe. Nuko Uhoraho arakira Hezekiya, arakira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose.
Mu nyuma Hezekiya yihana ubwibone bwo mu mutima wiwe, n’ab’i Yerusalemu; ivyo bituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bubavako, ntiyasubira kubarakira mu misi yose Hezekiya yabayeho.
Hezekiya yari afise ubutunzi bwinshi n’icubahiro, kandi yari yaraziganije ifeza n’inzahabu n’amabuye y’igiciro, n’ibimota neza, inkinzo n’ibindi bintu vy’igiciro kinini.
Yubaka kandi amazu yo kwimburiramwo ingano, imivinyu n’amavuta; yubaka n’impongore z’amasho y’ubwoko bwose, n’iz’imikuku y’intama n’impene.
Yubaka ibigwati yironkera ibitigiri binini vy’imikuku n’amasho, kuko Imana yari yamuhaye ubutunzi bwinshi cane.
Hezekiya ni we yagomeye amazi y’umugezi wa Gihoni aca ashiraho umuringoti w’amazi uyajana, uciye mu burengero bw’Igisagara ca Dawidi. Ivyo yipfuza gukora vyose yarabishikako.
Ariko igihe intumwa zatumwa kuri we zivuye ku baganza i Babiloni ngo bamubaze ivyerekeye ibitangaza vyari vyabaye mu gihugu, Imana iramureka kugira ngo imugeze imenye ivyari mu mutima wiwe vyose.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Hezekiya n’ibikorwa vyiwe vy’ubwizigirwa, vyanditswe mu vyo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe, biri mu gitabu c’abami b’i Buyuda n’abo muri Isirayeli.

Nuko Hezekiya ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ku gasozi ahari itongo bahambamwo abo mu ruvyaro rwa Dawidi. Amaze gupfa, Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu bamuha icubahiro. Maze Manase umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.

headings.text: Ubwibone bwa Hezekiya, ivyo yakoze, n’urupfu rwiwe

verses.text: Manase yabaye umwami afise imyaka cumi n’ibiri, aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n’itanu ari i Yerusalemu.
Manase akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu bizira vy’ubuyobe vyakorwa n’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere y’Abisirayeli.

Asubira kwubaka ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo, ku mataba y’imisozi, ivyo se Hezekiya yari yarasambuye; yongera kwubaka ibicaniro vya Bayali, ashinga n’inkingi za Ashera. Yunamira ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru arabisenga.
Yubaka ibicaniro mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , iyo Uhoraho yari yaravuzeko ati: “Izina ryanje rizoba i Yerusalemu ibihe vyose.”
Mu rugo rwose rw’Ingoro y’Uhoraho ahubaka ibicaniro vy’ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru.

Agera n’aho atanga abahungu biwe kw’ibimazi vyo guturirwa mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, agendera mu bupfumu n’amareba, akoresha abahamagara imizimu na ba kamenyi. Akora ibibi vyinshi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , bimutera kuraka.

Afata inkingi ya Ashera yabazishije, ayishira mu Ngoro, imwe Imana yari yabwiye Dawidi n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo iti: “Muri iyi Ngoro n’i Yerusalemu ni ho natoranije mu yindi miryango yose ya Isirayeli, ngo hitirirwe izina ryanje ibihe vyose.

Sinzosubira gutuma Abisirayeli bakura ikirenge hasi ngo bave mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza, nibitwararika gukora ivyo nabategetse vyose, bagakurikiza ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, amabwirizwa n’amategeko nabahaye ncishije ku musavyi wanje Mose.”
Ariko Manase azimiza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose, bituma bakora ibibi birengeye ivy’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarahonereje imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Uhoraho aburira Manase n’abantu biwe, ariko ntibavyitaho.
Nuko Uhoraho abateza abakuru b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Ashuri, bafata Manase bamugira imbohe, bacisha igera mu zuru ryiwe, bamubohesha iminyororo y’ubutare bw’umwakaka, maze bamujana i Babiloni.
Abonye ko ari mu mubabaro mwinshi, arondera Uhoraho Imana yiwe, yicisha bugufi cane imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Atakambiye Uhoraho , na we aterwa n’akagongwe yumva ugutakamba kwiwe; maze amugarukana i Yerusalemu no mu bwami bwiwe. Nuko Manase amenya ko Uhoraho ari Imana.

Inyuma y’ivyo aca yubaka uruzitiro rw’inyuma y’Igisagara ca Dawidi, mu burengero bw’umugezi Gihoni mu kiyaya, gushika kw’Irembo ry’Amafi, no kuzunguruka umusozi wa Ofeli; arongera arugira rurerure cane. Ashiraho abatwara ingabo mu bisagara vyose bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda.
Akuraho imana z’abanyamahanga, akuraho na ca gishushanyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , n’ibicaniro vyose yari yarubatse ku musozi w’Ingoro n’i Yerusalemu; abiterera inyuma y’igisagara.
Hanyuma asana igicaniro c’ Uhoraho agitangirako ibimazi vy’ishimwe n’ibimazi vyo gukenguruka, aca abwira Abayuda ngo bakorere Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Ariko abantu bakomeza gutangira ibimazi ku bicaniro vyo ku mataba y’imisozi, mugabo babishikanira Uhoraho Imana yabo gusa.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Manase, harimwo n’isengesho yasenze Imana yiwe, amajambo aberekwa bamubwiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, vyanditswe mu bitabu bidonda ivyagenda biraba ku ngoma z’abami b’Abisirayeli.

Isengesho ryiwe n’uburyo Imana yamugiriye ikigongwe kubera gutakamba kwiwe hamwe n’ibibi vyose yakoze, n’uguta ubwizigirwa, n’ahantu hose yubatse ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, akongera agashiramwo inkingi za Ashera n’ibigirwamana yunamira, vyose vyanditswe mu bitabu vy’aberekwa.
Nuko Manase arapfa; ahamvya ba sekuruza ahambwa ku kirimba iwe. Amoni umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.
Amoni yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka ibiri ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se Manase yakoze. Amoni asenga kandi atanga ibimazi ku bigirwamana Manase yari yaracurishije.
Ariko ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’uko se Manase yakoze; Amoni arushaho gukora ibibi.
Nuko abaganwa biwe baja inama yo kumugirira nabi, maze bamugandagurira mu ngoro iwe.
Ariko abantu bo muri ico gihugu baca bafata abishe umwami Amoni barabica, bimika Yosiya umuhungu wiwe, aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yosiya yari afise imyaka umunani igihe yaba umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo itatu n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe; agendera mu nzira za sekuruza Dawidi, ntiyahengamira i buryo canke i bubamfu.

Mu mwaka ugira umunani ari ku ngoma, mu gihe yari akiri muto, atangura kurondera Imana ya sekuruza Dawidi. Mu mwaka ugira cumi na kabiri atangura guhumanura i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, akuraho ibicaniro vyo hejuru ku mataba y’imisozi, akuraho inkingi za Ashera, akuraho n’ibishushanyo bibajwe n’ibicuzwe.

Ategeka ko basenyurira hasi ibicaniro vya Bayali; abomora ibicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza vyari hejuru kuri ivyo bigirwamana, asenyura n’inkingi za Ashera, ibigirwamana n’ibishushanyo. Ivyo yarabijanjaguye bicika umukungugu, aca awusuka ku mva z’ababishikaniye ibimazi;
yongera aturirira amagufa y’abaherezi ku bicaniro vyabo. Uko ni ko yahumanuye Ubuyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Mu bisagara vy’Abamanase, Abefurayimu n’Abasimeyoni gushika mu Banafutali, no mu misaka yose yari ihakikije,
ahomvorera hasi ibicaniro n’inkingi za Ashera, amenagura n’ibigirwamana bicika umukungugu, asenyagurira hasi ibicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza mu gihugu cose ca Isirayeli, aca asubira i Yerusalemu.

Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani umwami Yosiya ari ku ngoma, mu guhumanura igihugu n’Ingoro, arungika Shafani mwene Azaliya na Mayaseya umukuru w’igisagara, hamwe na Yowa mwene Yowahazi, umwanditsi, ngo basanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.

Baja kwa Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru bamuha amahera yari yazanywe mu Ngoro y’Imana, ayo Abalewi bari bajejwe kurinda amarembo bari baregeranije mu bantu bava mu miryango y’Abamanase n’Abefurayimu, mu masigarira yose y’Abisirayeli, mu bantu bose b’i Buyuda, mu muryango w’Ababenyamini no mu baba i Yerusalemu.
Na bo bayahereza abantu bagenewe gukurikirana ico gikorwa c’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho . Abo bantu bahemba abakora ibikorwa vyo gusanura no gusubiramwo ingoro.
Baha amahera ababaji n’abubatsi ngo bagure amabuye abajwe, n’imbaho zo kubarata hejuru, mu gusanura inyubakwa abami b’i Buyuda bari bararetse zikaba imisaka.

Abo bantu bakora igikorwa mu bwizigirwa. Yahati na Obadiya, Abalewi bava mu Bamerari, hamwe na Zakariya na Meshulamu, bava mu Bakohati, ni bo bari barongoye abandi. Mu Balewi, abari bafise ubuhinga bwo kuvuza ibicurarangisho,
ni bo bari bajejwe abakozi, bagakurikirana abakozi bose bari mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Bamwe bo mu Balewi bari abanyamabanga, abanditsi n’abarinzi b’amarembo.
Bakiriko barasohora amahera yari yazanywe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , Hilukiya umuherezi arenguka ku gitabu c’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho vyahawe Abisirayeli biciye kuri Mose.
Hilukiya abwira Shafani umwanditsi ati: “Ndatoye Igitabu c’Ivyagezwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .” Aca agiha Shafani.
Maze Shafani ashira ico gitabu umwami aca amubwira ati: “Abasavyi bawe bariko barakora ivyo basabwe gukora vyose.
Barakiriye amahera yari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bayazeza abashinzwe gukurikirana abakozi.”
Nuko Shafani umwanditsi arongera abwira umwami ati: “Hilukiya umuherezi yampaye igitabu.” Maze Shafani agisomera imbere y’umwami.
Umwami yumvise amajambo ari mu Vyagezwe, yitabagurirako impuzu.
Aca ategeka Hilukiya, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, Abudoni mwene Mika, Shafani umunyamabanga w’umwami na Asaya umukozi w’umwami, ati:

“Nimugende munsigurize Uhoraho , jewe n’amasigarira ari muri Isirayeli n’i Buyuda, ku vyerekeye ivyanditswe muri iki gitabu catowe. Uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwasutswe kuri twebwe burateye ubwoba kuko ba sogokuruza batitondeye ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , ngo bakore ibihwanye n’ivyanditswe muri iki gitabu.”

Hilukiya n’abo umwami yari yarungitse baja kuvugana na Hulida umuvugishwa, yari umugore wa Shalumu mwene Tokati, Tokati mwene Hasira uwari ajejwe imyambaro. Uwo Hulida yaba i Yerusalemu, mu gice gishasha c’igisagara.
Na we ababwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Nimugende mubwire uwabantumyeko muti:
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ngiye guteza icago aha hantu n’abantu baho, mu gushitsa imivumo yose yanditswe muri ico gitabu casomewe imbere y’umwami w’i Buyuda.
Kuko bantaye, bagaturirira ibimota neza izindi mana, bakandakisha izo nyene amaboko yabo yakoze, uburake bwanje buzosukwa aha hantu, kandi nta kizobuhwamika.’
Nimugende mubwire umwami w’i Buyuda yabatumye kumusiguriza Uhoraho, muti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ku vyerekeye amajambo wumvise:

Ko umutima wawe wakozweko, ukicisha bugufi imbere y’Imana ucumva amajambo yavuze kuri aha hantu no ku bantu baho, kandi ko wicishije bugufi imbere yanje ukitabagurirako impuzu, ukaririra imbere yanje; nanje nakwumvise, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
None rero nzoguha kwitahira amahoro uhamvye ba sogokuruza bawe. Amaso yawe ntazobona ivyago vyose ngiye guteza aha hantu n’abantu bose bahaba.’ ” Nuko bashira umwami iyo nyishu abahaye.
Maze umwami akoranya abakuru bose b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.

Adugana ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda, ababa i Yerusalemu, abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’abantu bose uhereye ku mukuru ugashitsa ku muto. Abasomera amajambo yo muri ca Gitabu c’Isezerano, cari catowe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umwami ahagarara mu kibanza ciwe, asubizaho isezerano imbere y’Uhoraho ko agiye kwubaha Uhoraho no gukurikiza amabwirizwa, amategeko hamwe n’ivyagezwe vyiwe, akabikora n’umutima wiwe wose n’umushaha wiwe wose, mu gushitsa ivyanditswe muri ico gitabu.
Asaba abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu n’Ababenyamini kwiyemeza gushira mu ngiro iryo sezerano. Maze ab’i Yerusalemu bakora bisunze iryo sezerano ry’Imana ya ba sekuruza.

Yosiya akuraho ibigirwamana vy’ubuyobe vyose mu ntara yitirirwa Abisirayeli, ategeka abari mu Bwisirayeli ngo bakorere Uhoraho Imana yabo. Mu gihe cose yari akiriho, ntibigeze bareka gukurikira Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza babo.
Yosiya ahimbariza Pasika y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, kandi babaga umwagazi wa Pasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere.
Ashira abaherezi mu bikorwa vyabo kandi abatera intege ngo bakore igikorwa c’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Abwira Abalewi, ari bo bajejwe kwigisha Abisirayeli kandi barobanuriwe Uhoraho , ati: “Nimushire ya Sandugu Yera mu Ngoro Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli yubaka. Ntimuzosubira kuyitwara ku bitugu vyanyu. Ubu rero nimukorere Uhoraho Imana yanyu n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Nimwitegure nk’uko imiryango yanyu iri mu mice yanyu, nk’uko mwabitegetswe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo.
Muhagarare Ahera muri kumwe n’Abalewi bavuye mu bice vyose vyo mu miryango yose ya benewanyu musangiye igihugu, hamwe n’abantu bose.
Mubage imyagazi ya Pasika, mwihumanure, maze mutegurire iyo myagazi bagenzi banyu b’Abisirayeli; mukore nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse abicishije kuri Mose.”
Yosiya ategurira abantu bose bari aho intama n’impene ibihumbi mirongo itatu vy’ibimazi vya Pasika, n’inka ibihumbi bitatu, ivyo vyose vyavuye mu butunzi bw’umwami.

N’abaganwa biwe na bo bazana ivyo guterera abantu bari ngaho n’abaherezi n’Abalewi. Hilikiya, Zakariya na Yehiyeli, abajejwe gukurikirana ivy’Ingoro y’Imana, baha abaherezi ibimazi vya Pasika ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atandatu vy’imyagazi y’intama n’impene hamwe n’inka amajana atatu.
Kandi na Konaniya hamwe na Shemaya na Netaneli, abavukana na we, na Hashabiya, Yeyiyeli na Yozabadi, abakuru b’Abalewi, baha Abalewi ibimazi vya Pasika ibihumbi bitanu n’inka amajana atanu.
Ico gikorwa kirategurwa, maze abaherezi bahagarara mu bibanza vyabo bari kumwe n’Abalewi, na bo bigabuye mu mice yabo nk’uko umwami yari yabitegetse.
Bakerera imyagazi ya Pasika, maze abaherezi baca bamijagira ku gicaniro amaraso bahawe n’Abalewi; Abalewi na bo baca bakora igikorwa co kuyikurako insato.
Batoranya ibimazi vyo guturirwa babishira i ruhande ngo babihe imigwi y’imiryango y’abantu; ngo na bo babishikanire Uhoraho , nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Mose. Babigenza gutyo no ku nka.

Botsa inyama za ya myagazi ya Pasika ku muriro nk’uko bitegekanijwe, baca bateka vya bimazi vyera mu nkono z’ibumba, no mu nkono zo gushusha amazi, eka no mu masafuriya, baca babigaburira abantu bose banyarutsa.

Inyuma y’ivyo, baca bategura ivyabo n’ivy’abaherezi, kuko abaherezi bakomoka kuri Aroni, bariko baratanga ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro n’ibinure gushika bwije. Ni co gituma Abalewi bateguye ivyabo n’ivy’abaherezi bene Aroni.

Abacuraranzi bakomoka kuri Asafu bari mu bibanza vyabo nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi, Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni uwerekwa w’umwami. Abarinzi bo ku marembo yose ntibarinda guhagarika igikorwa cabo, kuko Abalewi benewabo bari babateguriye ivyabo.
Nuko muri ico gihe igikorwa cose c’ Uhoraho kirakorwa kugira ngo bahimbaze Pasika, batange n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho , nk’uko umwami Yosiya yari yabitegetse.
Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli bari ngaho bahimbaza Pasika, barongera bamara iyindi misi indwi bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.

Ntihari bwigere hahimbazwa umusi mukuru wa Pasika nk’uwo mu Bisirayeli, uhereye mu gihe c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Samweli. Kandi nta n’umwe wo mu bami b’Abisirayeli yari bwahimbaze Pasika nk’uko Yosiya yayihimbaje, ari kumwe n’abaherezi, Abalewi n’Abayuda n’Abisirayeli bose, bari kumwe n’abantu b’i Yerusalemu.
Iyo Pasika yahimbajwe mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yosiya ari ku ngoma.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Yosiya amaze gutunganya neza ivyo mu Ngoro, Neko umwami wa Egiputa araduga ngo atere i Karikemishi ku ruzi Efurate; maze Yosiya aja kumutegera ngo amugwanye.

Ariko Neko arungika intumwa kuri we, amubwira ati: “Hari intambara nki hagati yawe nanje ga yewe mwami w’Abayuda? Ubu si wewe nje gutera, ariko hari irindi hanga duhamana ni ryo mviriye hasi. Imana yambwiye ngo nihute; nuko rero reka kugwanya Imana, kuko iri kumwe nanje, kandi yokurandura.”

Yamara Yosiya ntiyahindukira ngo amureke, ahubwo ariyoberanya ngo amutere. Ntiyumvira ivyo Neko yamubwiye ategetswe n’Imana, ahubwo aja kumugwanya; baca bahurira mu kiyaya c’i Megido ari ho bagwaniye.
Abagwanisha imiheto barasa umwami Yosiya; aca abwira abakuru b’ingabo biwe ati: “Nimunkure hano kuko nkomeretse cane.”
Nuko bamukura mu mukogote wiwe, bamushira mu wundi mukogote yari afise bamujana i Yerusalemu, apfirayo. Bamuhamba mu mva za ba sekuruza, maze Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu baramuririra.

Yeremiya yandika amajambo yo gucura intimba ku bwa Yosiya, kandi gushika n’ubu abagabo n’abagore b’abaririmvyi bose bama bibuka Yosiya mu gucura intimba. Ivyo vyabaye umugenzo mu Bisirayeli kandi vyanditswe mu ndirimbo zo gucura intimba.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yosiya n’ibikorwa vyiwe vy’ubwizigirwa, nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho
ivyabaye vyose, kuva ku ntango gushika kw’iherezo, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Maze abantu bo muri ico gihugu bafata Yehowahazi mwene Yosiya bamwimika ngo abe umwami i Yerusalemu mu gishingo ca se.
Yehowahazi yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itatu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza amezi atatu ari i Yerusalemu.
Umwami wa Egiputa amukura ku ngoma i Yerusalemu aca ategeka Abayuda ko batanga amashikanwa yo kwisaba angana n’italanto ijana z’ifeza n’italanto imwe y’inzahabu.

Umwami wa Egiputa yimika Eliyakimu avukana na Yehowahazi, ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu; ahindura izina ryiwe amwita Yehoyakimu. Ariko Neko atwara Yehowahazi umuvukanyi wa Eliyakimu amumanukana muri Egiputa.
Yehoyakimu yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu, akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe.
Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aramutera amubohesha iminyororo y’umwakaka amujana i Babiloni.
Nebukadineza yongera atwara i Babiloni ibikoresho vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho abishira mu ngoro yiwe i Babiloni.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu, ibibi vy’ubuyobe yakoze n’ivyamubayeko vyose, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda. Maze Yehoyakini umuhungu wiwe aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yehoyakini yari afise imyaka cumi n’umunani igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza amezi atatu n’imisi cumi ari i Yerusalemu. Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe.

Mu ntango z’umwaka, umwami Nebukadineza amutumako ngo bamuzane i Babiloni, hamwe n’ibikoresho vy’agaciro vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , aca yimika Zedekiya sewabo wa Yehoyakini, ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Zedekiya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’umwe igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, kandi ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya, yavuga ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Yongera agarariza umwami Nebukadineza, yari yaramurahije mw’izina ry’Imana. Yigira ntagondwa akomantaza umutima kandi ntiyahindukirira Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Vyongeye, abakuru mu baherezi n’abantu bose barushaho gukora ibibi, bakurikira ivy’ubuyobe vy’ayandi mahanga mu guhumanya Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , iyo yari yaratoranije ngo ibe i Yerusalemu.
Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, abatumako intumwa nyinshi, kuko yari agiriye akagongwe abantu biwe n’Ingoro yiwe.
Ariko bakengera izo ntumwa, bakengera n’amajambo yiwe, bahindura agatwengo abavugishwa na we gushika aho uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwaziriringiye ku bantu biwe ku buryo ata wari kuba agishobora kubakiza.

Abateza umwami w’i Babiloni, na we yicisha inkota urwaruka rwabo, mbere no mu Ngoro abicirayo, ntiyasigaza n’umwe yaba umusore canke inkumi, uwukuze canke umutama. Imana ibatanga mu maboko ya Nebukadineza.
Atwara i Babiloni ibintu vyose vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana, binini na bito, n’ubutunzi bwose bwari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ubutunzi bw’umwami n’abaganwa biwe.
Baturira Ingoro y’Imana kandi basenyurira hasi uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu; baturira ibirimba vyose, basambura n’ikintu cose c’agaciro cariyo.
Abasigaye bacitse kw’icumu abajana nk’inyagano i Babiloni, baba abo kumukorera we n’abahungu biwe kugeza ubwami bw’Abaperesi bugiye ku ngoma.
Igihugu kiruhuka akaruhuko k’Isabato. Igihe cose camaze ari umusaka, cararuhutse, kugeza imyaka mirongo indwi iheze nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryaravugiye muri Yeremiya.

Mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro ari umwami w’Ubuperesi, Uhoraho kugira ngo ashitse ijambo yari yaravuze aciye kuri Yeremiya, akangura umutima wa Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi na we atanga mu bwami bwiwe itegeko ryanditswe rivuga ngo:

“Ibi ni vyo Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi avuze: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru, yampaye ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi kandi yantoranije ngo ndamwubakire Ingoro i Yerusalemu i Buyuda. Umuntu wese wo mu bantu biwe ari muri mwebwe naduge, kandi Uhoraho Imana yiwe abane na we.’ ”
